articleTitle: Intelligent IoT Sensors: Types, Functions and Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper discusses the physicochemical effects in information, the principles of the effects of sensors, which determines the accuracy of the information received, the field of application of sensors such as monitoring, industry, etc., and also considers an example of the classification of sensors by the physical nature of primary information signals.

articleTitle: Communication Architecture of Solar Energy Monitoring Systems for Telecommunication Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The sources of energy supply for telecommunication stations are territorially distributed facilities with a multi-level management hierarchy and a large number of structural units. Monitoring them is one of the pressing issues, the main challenge of which is to develop an effective communication architecture for the monitoring system. This article analyzes the communication architecture of solar power supply monitoring, based on the analysis, a new architecture is developed that differs from the communication architecture of other monitoring systems. In this communication architecture, wireless sensor networks, which are considered cost-effective and practical in the application of solar power supply sources for remote monitoring systems, are analyzed. One of the leading directions in this field as a basic wireless sensor technology for monitoring system communication architecture is the development of recommendations for the use of ZigBee technology based on the IEEE 802.15.4 standard.

articleTitle: Research of Probability-Time Characteristics of the Wireless Sensor Networks for Remote Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A number of scientific researches are being carried out aimed at creating a remote monitoring system through wireless sensor networks to ensure a stable and high-quality power supply for telecommunications equipment in the world. To solve a number of problems in this area, including Smart Grid systems, including a remote monitoring system for wireless sensors, a two-way information system, energy consumption control, an increase in energy demand, reliability and safety models, algorithms, software and technical solutions, special attention is paid to paid. At the same time, research of characteristics of the wireless sensor networks for monitoring systems is considered relevant. This paper researches of probability-time characteristics of the wireless sensor networks for remote monitoring systems of telecommunication objects. In this case, a graph model reflecting the wireless sensor network was created and the characteristics were determined using the theory of the Pubic service system. The wireless sensor network was also simulated using Anylogic software and the results obtained were compared with the analytical results.

articleTitle: Methods for Automatic Identification of Vehicles in the its System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper deals with vehicle identification based on RFID technology, as well as intelligent transport system (ITS) classification, ITS components, classification of electronic identification means, radio frequency identification and the corresponding ISO standards. In the article, RFID technology is selected based on the materials discussed below. The identification methods are very diverse for different fields of application, i.e. each method is applicable to some and not applicable to some. For transport identification, identification technology such as RFID is more suitable. Accordingly, identification methods will be discussed below and emphasis will be placed on RFID technology.

articleTitle: Analysis for Comparison of Framework for 5G Core Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The next generation of wireless technology will provide new consumer and business applications with near realtime connectivity requirements. This will demand the use of hardware and software that allows flexibility, scalability and full use of resources to deliver performance and various functions. Therefore, an in-depth study of the platforms and frameworks available or under development was essential to select the most suitable one for implementing a 5G core network. This paper presents the study and feature comparison between three open-source platforms, Magma, Open5GS and Free5GC, used for the implementation of a 5G core network.

articleTitle: IoT and 5G technology in agriculture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article examines the development of agriculture through digitalization and robotization within Industry 4.0. To open this topic, the current state of agriculture is considered, such information as: about yield, soil, data on fertilization. As well as 5G communication technologies, in particular, the placement of sensors in the fields was investigated using the Cooja simulation environment.

articleTitle: Minimum logical representation of microcommands of cryptographic algorithms (AES)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The more optimally the algorithm is written into the device, the more energy, memory resources required by the device are saved and the speed increases. This article resolves the problem of optimal representation of modern Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) encryption algorithms on hard devices (microcontrollers). It is analyzed that the algorithms can be divided into microinstructions and used to determine their optimal (minimum) form by analyzing the type of graph-schemes, logical, algebraic and matrix representations.

articleTitle: Application of IoT technology in ecology (on the example of the Aral Sea region)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the depth of wells and salinity levels to take the results using IoT technology in Nukus of the Republic of Karakalpakstan, located in the Aral Sea region.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System Architectures in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The healthcare system is one of the rapidly developing areas where technical and technological innovations are introduced in the first place. Remote monitoring systems for patients, people requiring special care, and people who want to control their health are gaining more and more popularity, especially in recent years. Remote monitoring systems are diverse; in this paper, we have combined all possible systems and classified the architecture of the structure of these systems from the point of view of healthcare informatics. Remote monitoring systems are classified according to the nodes' interaction features, to the distribution of system functions, as well as according to the algorithms for the functioning of the system.

articleTitle: Development of An Algorithmic Model And Methods For Managing Production Systems Based On Algebra Over Functioning Tables
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, algorithmic methods and models of automated control of discrete production processes based on dynamic functioning tables are proposed. Control monitors are constructed, a method for describing and managing production systems based on algebra based on functioning tables is proposed. A complex of mathematical models and algorithms has been developed for solving problems of managing the organization of production and operational management in the tool shop of an industrial enterprise.

articleTitle: Problems Of Algorithmization Of Control Of Complex Systems Based On Functioning Tables In Dynamic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes how to effectively solve plan-ning problems from the point of view of operational efficiency of production process management. Therefore, the main task of this management task is the task of scheduling. In the conditions of discrete single production, the management of the organization of production should consist in the management of internal factors of the organizational environment of the production enterprise. The main issues of production systems management are issues related to achieving the main goal of the functioning of the production unit.

Author Keywords: final state of the functioning tables

articleTitle: Influence of Communication Lines on Reliability in Mobile Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this study, the assessment of the reliability of the mobile communication system, in particular, the impact of the communication lines on the base station - base station controllers system, was assessed. Base station - The type of communication lines and backup conditions are taken into account when assessing the reliability of the base station control system. An algorithm has been developed to evaluate the reliability of the system and the results obtained from the calculations are presented.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Calculating the Structural Reliability of a Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this study, algorithms for calculating the structural reliability of the mobile communication system were developed and the results of calculations were presented. At the same time, the calculation of the structural reliability of the situation centers of mobile communication stations in the center and outside the center was carried out.

articleTitle: Parametric Algorithm for Searching the Minimum Lower Unity of Monotone Boolean Functions in the Process Synthesis of Control Automates
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of minimizing Boolean functions is solved based on the search for the minimum lower unit of monotone Boolean functions, an algorithmic scheme is given for solving discrete extremal problems based on a parametric algorithm for finding the minimum lower unit (m.l.u) of monotone Boolean functions. The parameters of the algorithm for finding the minimum lower unit of monotone Boolean functions for solving certain classes of discrete extremal problems are calculated

articleTitle: Optimal representation in the form of logical functions of microinstructions of cryptographic algorithms (RSA, El-Gamal)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article resolves the problem of logical representation of the classical asymmetric RSA public key encryption algorithms (Rivest, Shamir, and Adleman) and El Gamal in order to implement them on hard devices (microcontrollers). It is shown that the algorithms under study can be described by a set of micro-instructions consisting of a sequence of operators and, based on the analysis of graph-schemes, logical, algebraic and matrix representations of algorithms, construct a minimal logical representation for implementation on hard devices

articleTitle: Mathematical model of Information Processing in the Ecological Monitoring Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The mathematical model of information processing has been developed in the Ecological Monitoring Information System (EMIS). This model is used to formalize the structure of information and its life cycle, simulate processing processes, formalize the impact on information and the movement of information, taking into account the factors of adaptation of the EMIS to the structure of subject activity. Working with information allows you to process information processes and implement them in algorithmic, software and theoretical-analytical analysis. The presented information processing processes scheme is used to formalize information flows in the ecological monitoring information system. The aim of the study is that agricultural production is under heavy pressure based on world population growth and significant changes in climate. This study discusses the concept of digital agricultural practices and their impact on agricultural productivity. The assessment of the current situation is carried out by digitization in agricultural areas located in the Aral Sea region. The methodology is used in this study as a method to assess the current state of digital applications for agriculture in the Aral Sea region. Agriculture is one of the most suitable methods for it, as digitalization is still in its infancy in the Aral Sea region. Digital agricultural technologies in the Aral Sea region are at an early stage of development, and the topics discussed in the world are aimed at making significant progress in raising awareness about farmers and other sectors of agriculture in the Aral Sea region. Although the current penetration of digital technologies is not large enough in terms of volume and quantity, the analysis of the methods used for agriculture can achieve the expected results as a result of the experience of developed countries.

articleTitle: Researching Of The Degradation Process Of Laser Diodes Used In Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article, experimental tests are carried out to predict the service life of DFB laser diodes used in optical communication systems. The experimentally obtained results were used to estimate the operating time of laser diodes of the DFB type. In this work, the method of automatic control of the power of optical radiation of a laser diode is used to study the process of degradation of laser diodes. For this, the current of the laser diode is regularly adjusted to ensure the stability of the optical radiation of the laser diode. When POC laser diodes are used in an optical transmitter module as a transmitter, the optical power is constantly monitored. Therefore, the use of the method of automatic control of the radiation power in the study of the process of failure of a laser diode provides a high compatibility of the experimental process with the real process of the laser diode operation.

articleTitle: Determination of the Reliability of Using Computing in Automation and Telemechanic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Microprocessor and information technologies are now widely used in automation and telemechanics systems. One of the possible ways to increase the safety of train traffic at stations is the use of microprocessor technologies, but the use of one computer to control automation and telemechanics devices cannot guarantee this safety. The proposed article discusses the issues of determining the reliability of the functioning of systems and offers schemes for connecting objects of control and monitoring of station devices.

articleTitle: Features of Technologies for Transmission of Radio and Television in 4G / 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Modern mobile networks have long since turned from telephone to multiservice networks, and the most dynamically developing area of services is video transmission. This is the category of traffic, the share of which in cellular networks is growing steadily every year. If in 2012 it accounted for half of the traffic, in 2016 – 60%, now it is about 70%, and by 2021 the share of video is expected to grow to 78%. And all this against the backdrop of a fivefold increase in the total volume of mobile traffic over the past years. Therefore, in the development of high-speed mobile communication standards, considerable attention is paid to video and television transmission technologies.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition Based On Transformer Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the creation of a speech recognition system in the Uzbek language based on the analysis of existing approaches to speech recognition and the selection of the preferred approach, which provides information on the End2End approach and its effective use. In addition, several manifestations of transformer neural networks have been analyzed. Based on the results of the analysis, high quality and efficiency were used in speech recognition in Uzbek. The results obtained showed that transformer-based models were superior to other widely used models in terms of training time and accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of LPWAN technologies for the implementation of IoT projects in the Republic of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: IoT technologies are already widely used in developed countries and adaptation is under way in developing countries, where wireless data transmission technologies that are not intended for transmitting sensor data are used for the implementation of IoT projects. In this paper, we investigate the possibility of introducing low-power networks with a long transmission range for IoT projects in developing countries using the example of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Analyzed the possibilities of the Republic for the implementation of IoT solutions. The adaptation of the most famous Low-Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN) such as Sigfox and LoRaWAN to the requirements of IoT projects in Uzbekistan is being investigated.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Results of EMG Signal Classification Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper has been provided information on the structure, modules and features of the hardware and software complex for classifying hand movements. The hardware-software complex is based on a modern BITalino device. The main idea of the paper is to classify more hand movements using fewer sensors. In the future, it will be possible to produce cheap and easy-to-use myoprostheses based on the scientific results presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and computational algorithm of vibration processes of thin magnetoelastic plates with complex form
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article deal with having algorithm of the solution of system equations expressing the state of deformation of the shell and thin a magnetoelastic plate under the influence of an electromagnetic field, the construction of a discrete model relatively to phase variables, the solution of a system differential equations based on the vector-matrices methods are developed. The state of deformation stress thin magnetoelastic plate and the shell under influence of the electromagnetic field is studied. As the result, the mathematical models in the form of a system of differential equations with high order special products with initial and boundary conditions relative to the migration are taken. To solve these mathematical models, ie to obtain numerical results, V.L.Rvachev's R-function (RFM), Bubnov-Galerkin, Gauss, Newmark and Iteration methods are used. In this work, the study of state a deformation thin plates of complex shape under the influence of an electromagnetic field, the construction of the boundary equation considered area using the method of R-function is studied.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Antenna Devices of Base Stations for Suburban and Mountain Routes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is about panel antennas for mobile communications. The main parameters of modern typical BTS antennas are given and the features of panel antennas, in contrast to other types of antennas, are also considered. In addition, the development and analysis of the current state and prospects are considered.

articleTitle: Parallel Implementation of Real-Time Object Detection using OpenMP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One of the urgent problems of the modern world is the detection and recognition of objects on a video stream in real-time. To work with a video stream, you need to split it into frames that are more convenient for processing. There is a possibility of using multi-core processors for image processing. Typically, the operating system allows only one core of multi-core processors to execute a task. But there are such parallelization tools that allow parallelizing execution when processing data on multi-core processors. And OpenMP is one of them that can be used in real-time object detection processing procedures. But in this case, the main thing is to find that part of the algorithm that is suitable for parallelization. Using OpenMP simply does not give an efficient accelerated result. In this paper, we discuss the implementation of OpenMP technology in real-time object detection algorithms on multi-core processors. Experimental results show that the use of OpenMP technology significantly improves the processing speed for real-time object detection on multi-core processors, when there are no GPUs.

articleTitle: Solving the problem of geometrical nonlinear deformation of electro-magnetic thin plate with complex configuration and analysis of results
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article the task of geometric nonlinear deformation of a thin plate of complex configuration is discussed taking into account the influence of the electromagnetic field forces. A mathematical model is obtained in the form of a system of partial differential equations with initial and boundary conditions for displacement according to the Hamilton-Ostrogradsky hypothesis using the Bund Kirgof-Love hypothesis, Cauchy relations, Hooke's law and the Lorentz degree, as well as the Maxwell electromagnetic tensor. For the numerical solution of the problem under study, a calculation algorithm is developed, the results are obtained and analyzed using together the method of analytical R-functions (RFM) of magnetoelastic plates of complex structural shape and the Bubnov-Galerkin variation method.

articleTitle: Traffic and road sign recognition using deep convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Automatic road sign recognition is one of the most important steps to help a driver prevent accidents. In this paper, the deep convolutional neural network (Deep CNN) was used for the autonomous traffic and road signs detection and recognition system. The proposed system works in real-time recognition of the image of road signs. The contribution of this article is that it consists of a newly developed datasets for 42 different road signs using combination of existing datasets and collected local road signs. The images were taken from different angles and included other parameters and conditions. More than 30K images were collected to create the dataset, which is named Uzbekistan traffic and road signs (UZ-TRS-2021). The CNN architecture was used with various parameters to achieve the best recognition speed. Experimental results show that the proposed CNN architecture achieved 98% accuracy.

articleTitle: Object Tracking Method Based on Kalman Filter and Camshift Algorithm for UAV Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Since the object tracking system for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and evaluating its effectiveness are a demanding task, we have focused our work on this topic. In this paper, we presented a method for tracking an object in image sequences. Our proposed method is based on the Kalman filter and Camshift algorithm. The Kalman filter is used to predict the location of an object, while the selected target is tracked by the Camshift algorithm. The results of our experiments demonstrated that the proposed method can effectively track an object in various videos.

articleTitle: Increasing Data Reliability By Using Bigdata Parallelization Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, process management based on digital technologies leads to the minimization of human labor and costs, and a sharp increase in work efficiency. In the current information age and globalization, the rapid increase in the flow of data, the development of storage, processing and transmission of data in network technologies remains relevant. Consequently, the increase in data flow on computer networks creates big data. Big data processing and increasing the reliability of big data serve to create a factor of high-quality data processing. Implementing parallelism and distribution mechanisms to improve data reliability in big data will determine the solution to the problem. This study looked at implementing a parallelism mechanism to improve data reliability in big data improving data reliability in networked systems.

articleTitle: Modeling the decision-making process of lenders based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, the credit system is finalized to ensure the implementation of the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated May 12, 2020 No. 5992 «On the Strategy for Reforming the Banking System in the Republic of Uzbekistan for 2020-2025». Information security problems in the credit system and their solutions, as well as effective modeling of lender-borrower relations, model iterative calculation and quantitative analysis of the assessment of loan funds by credit institutions based on established criteria, the introduction of a two-way graphical method for assessing the decision-making process, development of decision-making models by banks and other credit organizations as an integral part of the UzBCS credit platform (Uzbekistan Blockchain Credit System), a mathematical model of an integrated decision-making process has been proposed that allows banks and other organizations to evaluate and select reliable borrowers.

articleTitle: Features Application of Sensor Networks for Measurement of Raw Cotton Bunts
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, wireless sensor networks are widely used in all industries including manufacturing, construction, agriculture, hydrometeorology, industrial, medical, warehousing, plant security, and other systems. The flexibility of wireless sensor networks, interoperability with various technologies, quick and easy acquisition of measured values as well as early warning and early detection of possible disasters and data transmission rates are used in many areas. This article describes the special features of temperature measurement and control in warehouses, the structure of sensor networks and data processing via wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of Information Reliability in BigData and Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This study examines the directions and mechanisms for improving data reliability in Bigdata and blockchain technologies. Currently, there is a sharp increase in data flow, data processing is performed in computer networks, and an increase in the volume of data also leads to an increase in the problem of data reliability. It is important to identify solutions based on the use of modern technologies to solve these problems. Observations show that data reliability violations are mainly observed in three areas, namely due to artificial and natural redundancy in data transmission, the integrity of interconnected data in data transmission and storage, and errors in large-scale data processing. The features and capabilities of Bigdata class data and blockchain technology to improve data reliability were mentioned. Data from the Bigdata class was analyzed to improve the reliability of data based on blockchain mechanisms.

articleTitle: Formant set as a main parameter for recognizing vowels of the Uzbek language
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article highlights the applications of the algorithm for speech signal recognition using a formant set. A description of the formation of the speech signal by the human articulating apparatus is given. The influence of the human speech apparatus organs on the formant parameter is also described. The Linear Prediction Method (LPC) is used for determining the formant set in order to identify the peaks on the spectral diagram of the original signal. The paper presents the formant set for the Uzbek vowels pronounced by several speakers of the same age category with different genders after cochlear surgery. Based on the formant set graphs are constructed and classification problems over them are solved using machine learning algorithms such as K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, Support Vector Machines. The scientific paper consists of a comparative analysis of the three main classification methods on such a priority parameter as recognition accuracy in order to simplify the process of speech signal recognition. The results of the classification revealed that the recognition of Uzbek vowel letters on the basis of the formant set is achieved using KNN and is 95%.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Formalization Of User Access To The Ecological Monitoring Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, economic science and practice are increasingly using the achievements of applied mathematics, turning them from a weapon of scientific research into an important tool for effectively solving complex agricultural problems. The paper describes the use of digital technologies in monitoring the environmental situation, groundwater salinity in observation wells located in the Aral Sea regions, using information security methods for transmitted data. In the course of the study, algorithmic formalization of user access to the information system of environmental monitoring was carried out when monitoring changes in levels.

articleTitle: Classification Based On Decision Trees And Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the approach of classification of texts by decision trees and neural networks, in which the quantitative properties of texts are formed as a set. A detailed description of the approaches and examples of text classification are given. Each approach is compared with classification performance, number of authors, characteristics, and parameters chosen.

articleTitle: Image Features Selection Based on Computer Vision Techniques to Detect Potholes for Intelligent Transport System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Computer vision is an emerging area for image processing that is well utilized in the field of Intelligent Transport Systems. There are various techniques used to increase the efficiency of ITS such as GPS, radar-based, sensors utilization, more importantly, through Surveillance, etc. It found that costs for all techniques were high to implement on a large scale. The need of the hour is to have efficient techniques or models that will help to reduce the cost of ITS. Computer vision is a field that provides cutting-edge solutions in ITS. This paper explores the image features selection based on computer vision techniques to detect the potholes on the road. It will help to improve the Intelligent Transport System for a smart city. In this paper, the authors will discuss the computer vision techniques like Corner Detection-Harris, HOG, and Feature Extraction through FAST.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based E-Voting System: Open Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Blockchain technology has become very trendy and penetrated different domains, mostly due to the popularity of cryptocurrencies. Blockchain technology offers decentralized nodes for e-voting and is used to create e-voting systems, mainly because of their end-to-end verification benefits. This technology is an excellent replacement for traditional e-voting solutions with distributed performance, reliability and security. The following article provides an overview of e-voting systems based on blockchain technology. The main purpose of this analysis was to examine the current state of blockchain-based voting systems, as well as any associated difficulties in predicting future events.

articleTitle: Development of an algorithm for optimizing energy-saving management processes in intelligent energy systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the development of an algorithm for optimizing energy-saving management processes in intelligent energy systems, the main problems of the functioning of energy-saving management processes in enterprises and provides methods and algorithms for their solution. The paper presents a modified algorithm for optimizing energy-saving management processes in intelligent energy systems, which includes solving the problems of regulation, optimal planning, operational accounting, control and management decisions on the rational regulation of the consumption of fuel and energy resources

articleTitle: Speaker Separation: Use Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Speaker separation is the problem of separating speakers in an audio. There could be any number of speakers and final result should state when speaker starts and ends. In this project, we analyze given audio file with 2 channels and 2 speakers (on separate channel). We train Neural Network for learning when a person is speaking. We use different type of Neural Networks specifically, Single Layer Perceptron (SLP), Multi Layer Perceptron (MLP), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) we achieve uzbek speech commands ~88% of accuracy with RNN.

articleTitle: Agro-field Boundary Detection using Mask R-CNN from Satellite and Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Agriculture is important to the food security and economic growth of most countries in the world, especially in developing countries. Accurate information on field boundaries has considerable importance in precision agriculture and greatly assists land administration systems. This paper proposes a deep learning-based approach, for detecting and boundary segmentation of agricultural fields based on the state-of-the-art instance segmentation approach, Mask Region Convolutional Neural Network (Mask R-CNN). This model can accurately detect each agricultural field in the satellite and aerial image. The experimental results indicate that our automated approach can detect agricultural fields more accurately.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Methods For Filtering Spam Messages In Email Services
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper describes methods for classify spam messages in electronic mail services. Considered algorithms of machine learning based spam filtering. The characteristics and effectiveness of spam filters based on artificial intelligence methods are analyzed.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition Method Based on Simplified Gabor Wavelets and CNNs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, as the number of cars increases, it is important to solve the problem of The automatic traffic sign detection and recognition (TSDR). We aimed to identify road signs from the images that provide information about the road infrastructure. A simplified Gabor wavelet filter provides good efficiency in identifying an important feature of traffic signs. convolutional neural networks (CNNs) is most commonly used in recognizing objects from images. In our approach, the simplified Gabor wavelet filter and CNN detection of traffic signs gave good results.

articleTitle: Antenna array power supply circuit in marine communication systems using the topology of a compact coupler
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: At low frequencies, there is a problem with miniaturization of directional couplers in the maritime telecommunication system, since these devices take up a lot of space. A variant of a compact coupler in microstrip design is presented. The results of simulation of such a device with an operating frequency of 0.9 GHz and on a FR 4 substrate are presented. The use of artificial transmission lines made it possible to reduce the size, but at the same time there was a narrowing of the operating frequency band.

articleTitle: Determination of Characteristic Points Based on Wavelet Change of Electrocardiogram Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In order to analyze and diagnose a biosignal-electrocardiogram (ECG) signal generated during a heartbeat on a computer, it is first necessary to automatically identify and locate its QRS characteristic points. The article deals with the programming of the ECG R tooth detection algorithm in LabView, using the currently popular, powerful mathematical tool - wavelet analysis and synthesis.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Architecture of Dual-Core Blackfin Digital Signal Processors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, special processors are widely used in digital processing of signals. Analog devices are one of the largest companies producing custom processors. This article compares and analyzes the functional descriptions of Analog Devices' Blackfin dual-core processor architecture. The architectures of the ADSP-BF561 and ADSP-BF60x processors are described, their capabilities and areas of application are described. The peripherals of single-core and dual-core processors are compared in the table. The core architecture of Blackfin processors is given and its constituents are described. The hierarchical memory architecture of dual-core Blackfin processors is given. Also included are tables comparing the internal memory of the Blackfin processor family, first-class L1 memory in the core. The internal memories of ADSP-BF561 and ADSP-BF60x Blackfin processors are compared.

articleTitle: Improving image contrast: Challenges and solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article provides a comparative analysis of some algorithms that widely used nowadays for improving image contrast. While the estimating effectiveness of the algorithms, we took attention to the preserving the brightness of the image and characteristic features of the image and the increasing visual quality of the image. Criteria such as PSNR, SSI, AMBE, which assesses image quality, were also used during the experiments

articleTitle: A method to improve the quality of service and overcome the loss of network packets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper provides a scheme of how the QUIC protocol works and analyzes the functioning of the QUIC protocol to strengthen the TCP protocol. A traffic filtering scheme by inserting a TCP pseudo-header and transmitting a stream with QUIC protocol support to minimize the loss of network packets is proposed.

articleTitle: Finding optimal architecture of neural networks for predicting referrals on the virtual museums website
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents applying two neural network models for time series prediction problems. focused choosing optimal architecture of Elman and feedforward neural networks for time series prediction. Topics discussed include neural network design, overview methods of forecasting, sliding window method, training and testing of network, training algorithms and all results obtained with neural network toolbox in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Organization of video surveillance at railway crossings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, the railway industry requires railway telecommunication networks to provide modern, high-quality services to manage the transportation process. All types of railway transport are in dire need of proven and standardized wireless technologies for various purposes: mobile communications, wireless access, short-range communication. The use of wireless technologies should become one of the main directions of innovative development of railway transport, increasing its efficiency and safety and, as a result, competitiveness and attractiveness for passengers and shippers. A railroad crossing is the intersection of a railroad and road transport, and sometimes a stuck vehicle (or other obstacle) is a greater threat to traffic safety and the timeliness of train arrival. The organization of video surveillance using wireless technologies in railway transport is an urgent task.

articleTitle: Study of Neural Networks in Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents the structure of artificial and recurrent neural networks for phenomena, which makes it possible to reproduce rather complex dependencies and presents the architecture of a recurrent neural network with feedback, containing a hidden layer of neurons.

articleTitle: Results of analysis of multimedia traffic of elements of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article offers options for reference models for the construction and interaction of Internet of Things (IoT) systems. The results of solving the problem are presented, namely, data acquisition and traffic analysis of devices used in smart home systems - smart sockets. Sockets manufactured by TP-Link and Redmond are considered. For more accurate traffic data, both the data generated and received by the outlets are considered. The obtained results of information about the operation of the presented devices can be used for a deeper study in order to predict jumps in the volume of traffic and the behavior of the system as a whole, as well as for directly computer models of networks of intelligent devices.

articleTitle: Models of integration of higher education management information systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the problems of automating business processes in higher educational institutions, the development and implementation of high education management information systems, a model for integrating data, applications and information systems. The main capabilities and role of the high education management information systems in higher educational institutions are presented. The methods of internal and external data integration between various information systems are described

articleTitle: Lightweight Cryptography Algorithms for IoT Devices: Open issues and challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: IoT have become popular in recent years with it's widespread use in a variety of environments. In this system, the data collected from the sensors is transmitted over a network. In this case, reliable network protection mechanisms are required. This article presents the open issues and problems that exist in the design and implementation of LWC (Lightweight Cryptography) algorithms that serve to ensure security in IoT systems. In addition, the tools used in the implementation of LWC algorithms in different environments, the results of the implementation of existing LWC algorithms in the software and hardware environment are given detailed.

articleTitle: Development and application of computer graphics training software in information technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the didactic potential for the use of a modern multimedia textbook as software, as an auxiliary visual means of teaching computer graphics. The article gives instructions and suggestions for teaching and popularization of the subject of computer graphics on the basis of modern electronic textbooks and their use.

articleTitle: Improving Data Hiding Methods in Network Steganography Based on Packet Header Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, internet is among the basic necessities of life. Internet has changed each and everybody's lives. So confidentiality of messages is very important over the internet. Steganography is the science of sending secret messages between the sender and intended receiver. It is such a technique that makes the exchange of covert messages possible. Each time a carrier is to be used for achieving steganography. The carrier plays a major role in establishing covert communication channel. This survey paper introduces steganography and its carriers. This paper concentrates on network protocols to be used as a carrier of steganograms. There are a number of protocols available to do so in the networks. Network steganography describes various methods used for transmitting data over a network without it being detected. Most of the methods proposed for hiding data in a network do not offer an additional protection to the covert data as it is sent as plain text. This paper presents a framework that offers the protection to the covert data by encrypting it and compresses it for gain in efficiency.

articleTitle: Research of the elementary section of a gas pipeline under gas outflow from its end to the environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Within the framework of hyperbolic equations of gas state on a short elementary section of a gas pipeline, the problem of gas outflow from the end of the section through the choke was formulated using N.E. Zhukovsky's formula on the rate of gas outflow as a boundary condition.

articleTitle: Automatic Liquid Level For Explosive Areas
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper describes the capabilities and principles of operation of a liquid level transmitter for hazardous areas. The level gauge is designed for technological accounting and control. The block diagram of the level gauge is given. The automatic liquid level meter for explosive zones is designed for operation in explosive zones to measure various levels with appropriate settings, the cost is significantly lower than that of ready-made explosion-proof level meters and has a measurement accuracy of 0.5-1% To measure and control levels, the value of the fitting resistance is calculated, where the main parameters of the fitting is to obtain a 4–20 mA unified signal. The automatic liquid level meter uses the TRM 101 controller-meter. The developed system is aimed at automatic retention of the oil level in the reactor, the main element in the level gauge is a constant resistance of 680 kom. The cost of the level gauge is significantly lower than that of industrial level gauges and it does not require large costs to build a level gauge.

articleTitle: Development of a Prototype of a Search and Rescue Robot Equipped with Multiple Cameras
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Search and Rescue Robotics is a field of research with practical but promising potential. The use of robotic systems in post-disaster search and rescue operations provides a rapid response to finding victims in a disaster area. Disasters occur suddenly and cause damage to people and property belonging to them. Search and Rescue Robots can be used in a disaster zone for various purposes such as searching for victims, removing rubbles, delivery of supplies, treatment, and evacuation of victims. In recent years, the role of Search and Rescue Robot has been increasing in a post-disaster operations. The contribution of various types of robots in search and rescue operations, such as humanoid robots, aerial robots, marine robots and rescue robots, wheeled and crawler robots, is increasing. In this paper, we develop a multifunctional search and rescue robot system for use in search and rescue operations. With the help of this robot, it is possible to remotely monitor the disaster zone in real-time.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models for Calculation of Limits in Water Resources Management in Irrigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the present article, algorithms for calculating limits in water resources management in irrigation systems were carried out and the problems of water resources management of the Basin Irrigation Systems Administration which were studied is characterized by the fact that it is necessary to solve the problems of collecting and processing information about the control object from large territories and to manage its links, which are located at large distances from each other.

articleTitle: 3D Tensor-based Deep Learning Models for Predicting Option Price
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Option pricing is a significant problem for option risk management and trading. In this article, we utilize a framework to present financial data from different sources. The data is processed and represented in a form of 2D tensors in three channels. Furthermore, we propose two deep learning models that can deal with 3D tensor data. Experiments performed on the Chinese market option dataset prove the practicability of the proposed strategies over commonly used ways, including B-S model and vector-based LSTM.

articleTitle: Differential characteristics of reflections of Kuznyechik encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The study of the differential characteristics of the Kuznyechik encryption algorithm is important for carrying out cryptanalysis methods relative to the algorithm. This article discusses a method for obtaining increments for bits that are more likely than a permutation table.

articleTitle: Method for false attack detection in face identification system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article analyzes and evaluates the state of the problem of detecting a printed attack, false data entry into the biometric identification system. The existing methods of replacing the biometric properties of registered users are discussed, as well as methods of combating counterfeiting in biometric systems using motion analysis, analysis of local movements on the face and recognition of facial images based on the assessment of facial vitality. The directions of research to improve the effectiveness of methods for combating false input data have been determined.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of face detection and recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Paper describes the analysis of methods for detecting and tracking faces, as well as recognition algorithms in the development of systems for recognizing faces in images and videos. The difficulties arising in solving problems of detection and recognition are considered.

articleTitle: Parallel Processing of Signals in Local Spline Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of constructing cubic spline functions of a local character with equal distances between nodes. Previous studies have shown precise models for digital processing of signals using interpolated cubic splines, with concrete examples showing the high degree of accuracy of the approximation of interpolated functions. In this work, the size of the calculations required to find the parameters to be determined during the construction of the spline function does not depend on the number of node points. Local-based splines are used to build such spline functions. Our body constantly provides information about our health. That is, it provides information about the heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation level, blood glucose level, digestive activity, brain activity, and so on the activities of our other organs. Today, this information can be obtained in the form of signals by physiological means. Traditionally, such measurements are made at specific points in time and are given in tabular form. In most cases, physicians 'diagnosis and treatment will be based on the results in this table. Biomedical signal processing contributes greatly to providing useful information about how physicians make decisions about patients 'illnesses. This plays an important role in the development of the medical field. Today, scientists are exploring new ways to process these signals using a variety of mathematical models and algorithms. One of these methods is the problem of restoring the signal received in tabular form by spline functions. As an example, the first experimental data of the gastroenterological signal were taken. Thus, on the basis of the spline-function model discussed in the article, digital processing of the gastroenterological signal was performed and error results in the process of signal interpolation were obtained.

articleTitle: Algorithms to Synthesis for Adaptive Sub-Optimal Control of Dynamic Objects Based on Regular Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Regular algorithms for the synthesis of adaptive suboptimal control of dynamic objects based on regular methods are presented. Moreover, the statistical properties of the variational method for identifying linear dynamical systems are described. To determine the variational estimate of the parameters on the system, the conditions of the minimum “distance” between the set of measurements and the set of trajectories of the model are used. The possibilities of the variational method are analyzed to solve the problem of parametric identification when the length of observation interval is limited. To add, the algorithms presented allow to regularize the considered problem of adaptive suboptimal control of dynamic objects based on regular methods.

articleTitle: Inter-Zone Light Absorption in a Size Quantized Wire
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The wave functions and energy spectrum of the unbound state of the Wannier-Mott exciton in a semiconductor wire in the presence of size quantization have been determined. Numerical calculations of the coefficient of interband light absorption are carried out taking into account exciton effects. It is shown that the interaction of an electron and a hole leads to the appearance of new anomalies in the spectrum of interband absorption and the Sommerfeld factor.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Intelligent Data Processing in Resource Management Under Uncertainty and Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses algorithms for intelligent data processing that improve the efficiency of solving resource management problems in conditions of uncertainty and dynamism of the external environment. As a fundamental information technology that provides collection, storage, retrieval, processing and use of data and knowledge for resource management in conditions of uncertainty and semantic constraints of the subject area, data processing technology using a multi-agent approach has been chosen. The solution to the problem in the form of a resource allocation plan is built as a result of agents negotiating with each other. Agents participating in the negotiation process determine the admissibility and acceptability of a solution for them based on an individual knowledge base. The possibility of self-learning of agents of a multi-agent system is laid down at the level of individual knowledge bases belonging to individual agents. New knowledge gained as a result of negotiation in solving the problem of resource management, as well as based on the experience gained, update the knowledge base of agents in the form of appropriate rules and restrictions, which can be used in the future to improve their efficiency. The algorithms were tested on the example of solving the resource management problem in production scheduling.

articleTitle: An approach to finding the most optimal route in a dynamic graph
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article proposes an algorithm for determining the optimal ways for users to travel from one place to another. Traffic jams occur in cities as a result of road repairs and car accidents. As a result, the shortest route planned for the trip can become a useless route. Given these circumstances, the article presents a parallel processing method distributed on a large-scale graph to control traffic. As a result, an algorithm for parallel and distributed processing of large-volume graphs was developed and tested for large-volume data. The test algorithm is illustrated with a wide range of graphs. Experimental experiments of the algorithm were conducted on the basis of data from the city of Urgench, Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: SLR: A Systematic Literature Review on Blockchain Applications in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In a very less time from its advent, blockchain technology has entered into mainstream research all over the world. The Bitcoin cryptocurrency is the first open-source implementation of blockchain technology. The application of blockchain technology is not restricted to financial services only; several other sectors especially healthcare is increasingly focusing their attention to grab potential and unique features of blockchain technology like immutability, security, and trust. This paper aims to review the exploration of blockchain technology in the healthcare domain in recent years and study how these emerging technologies help healthcare to speed up treatment procedures and mitigate the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Three-Dimensional Gas Filtration Process in Porous Media
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper deals with development of multidimensional model of gas filtration in porous media and numerical algorithm for solving the initial-boundary value problem. The model consists of nonlinear differential equation in partial derivatives with the appropriate initial and boundary conditions. The model makes it possible to evaluate impact of main factors affecting the filtration process such as permeability, porosity, thickness of layers, gas recovery coefficient, viscosity etc. That gives us opportunity to solve practical problems of forecasting the process of gas production as well as making decisions on exploitation of gas deposits.

articleTitle: Advantages using of the contour analysis method for detecting fire from video images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Analysis of video data related to the rapid detection of fires plays an important role in assessing the risk of exacerbation of situations, suppression or mitigation of their consequences. However, nowadays, most fire safety systems use “point detectors” that simply sound the alarm. This article discusses the contour method as an additional test to the fire detection method based on color pixel analysis. The contour analysis method complements the color analysis method and improves the result. Algorithms and hardware software for both methods were developed, as well as a comparative analysis of the methods presented in the article in the form of tables and graphs. The method based on the analysis of object contours increases the result of fire detection and reduces the number of false alarms.

articleTitle: Model and research of time parameters of service traffic of a wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the models developed to assess the connection of WSN nodes and the delivery time of messages, as well as a methodology for choosing sensors. The route model and mathematical calculation are presented as a multi-level system of public services. In order to plan and build a wireless sensor network with quality of service requirements, it is necessary to develop models that are capable of adequately assessing the performance parameters of a wireless sensor network (WSN).

articleTitle: Analysis of methods for ensuring reliability indicators of PON networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the principles of using PON networks and their reliability. It also analyzes ways to ensure the reliability of these industries. The purpose of this article is to study the reliability of Passive optical network technology based on the analysis of various network protection schemes and the possibilities of their use for PON networks, respectively.

articleTitle: Creating an application for training science
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article contains scientific and theoretical materials on ICT programs and software products for their use in the educational process, designed to quickly update information and restore feedback.

articleTitle: Neutrosophic Sets and Their Decision-Making Methods on the Example of Diagnosing Cattle Disease
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses a method for determining the type of disease in cattle using neutrosophic sets and their decisionmaking methods. In our country, diseases of osteodystrophy and ketosis in cattle are determined quite wrongly in determining the type of disease due to their similar symptoms. Since the symptoms of these diseases are interrelated and one of them can cause the other, solving this problem using neutrosophic sets and their decision-making methods helps to reduce the error in determining the type of disease.

Author Keywords: Interval neutrosophic weighted exponential aggregation (IN-WEA) operator
Dual interval neutrosophic weighted exponential aggregation (DINWEA) operator

articleTitle: Analysis Password-based Authentication Systems with Password Policy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Passwords are the most common form of authentication used to control access to information, ranging from the personal identification numbers we use for automatic teller machines, credit cards, telephone calling cards, and voice mail systems to the more complex alphanumeric passwords that protect access to files, computers, and network servers. Passwords are widely used because they are simple, inexpensive, and convenient mechanisms to use and implement. At the same time, passwords are also recognized as being an extremely poor form of protection. In this paper, password based authentication systems are analyzed with password policy and recommendation is given to improve password related problems.

articleTitle: Analysis and Implementation of Course Quality Optimization based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the role of Internet networks and technologies in improving the quality of lessons, the concept and definition of cloud classroom, cloud classroom students' learning objectives and learning resources from the network, communication with teachers and other students through the network and the fact that the process of using it as a way to build one's own knowledge is presented, that the traditional online education system cannot solve the problem of overloading data in the learning mode, and so on and so forth. in problem solving this article offers an online learning system in a cloud classroom under a system of personal recommendations. The proposed system adopts an algorithm of recommendations for co-filtering, which helps to identify potential desires of users and thus complements the recommendations more precisely.

articleTitle: Detecting spam messages using the naive Bayes algorithm of basic machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, we consider the definition of spam messages using the naive Bayes algorithm based on machine learning and study the algorithm of inclusion. A table has been compiled for determining spam/non-spam by example and calculating using the naive Bayes algorithm based on machine learning.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Frequency of Letters of the Uzbek Language Based on the Cyrillic Alphabet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The current state of cryptography has deep historical scientific roots. And these results had a strong impact on the development of cryptography tools and methods. These methods, of course, are directly related to the development of cryptanalysis methods. The first method of cryptanalysis is the frequency method. The first traces of frequency analysis of the text can be found in the works of scientists of the East since the X century. For example, scientists like Al-Kindi have made a great contribution to cryptanalysis. This paper presents a frequency analysis of the text in the Uzbek language based on the Cyrillic alphabet. At the same time, it should be noted that at the moment the Uzbek language is based on the Latin alphabet. And now further changes in the alphabet of the Uzbek language are being considered. Determining the frequencies of the letters of the Latin alphabet of the Uzbek language is accompanied by difficulties associated with the fact that some letters are combinations of letters from the original alphabet, for example, the letter ‘sh’. Here the letters ‘s’ and ‘h’ belong to this alphabet. And this, in turn, leads to problems when defining bigrams. Based on this, the texts in the Uzbek language are analyzed here using the Cyrillic alphabet, where each letter corresponds to one character. Texts from official web resources are used as content. Based on this, in this article, we present the results on determining the letter frequencies of the Uzbek language, with a further comparison with other languages.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of flow through an axisymmetric two-dimensional plane diffuser based on a new two-fluid turbulence model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents the results of a numerical study of the structure of flow through axisymmetric two-dimensional diffusers. The calculations were performed on the basis of solving the system of nonstationary equations of the two-fluid Malikov turbulence model. As a result, the longitudinal velocity profiles in different cross sections of the channel were investigated, and it was shown how grid changes affect the results of the study. The SIMPLEC algorithm was applied for the difference approximation of the initial equations. The viscous terms were approximated by the central difference and, for the convective terms, the counter-flow A.A. Samarsky scheme was used. The correctness of the results was confirmed for Reynolds number Re=20000 by comparing the numerical results with known experimental data. The comparison showed that the new model is able to predict the separated flows with great accuracy.

articleTitle: Workload Characteristics in Cloud Data Centers: A Computational Study from Alibaba Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Cloud computing is trending in today's digital era in every form and scaling to a peak in order to deliver the mutual expectations for Cloud consumers and providers through Cloud Data Center's. One such data center so called Alibaba Cloud's Data Cluster is analysed in this paper. The online services and Batch jobs co-exist in the same data cluster which leads to multiplexing of resource utilization in Cloud Data Center's. Therefore our findings and insights from this data production cluster allows the community and data center operators better understand the various workload patterns to improve the resource utilization and failure recovery design.

articleTitle: Organization of lessons by creating educational projects in small groups
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of interactive teaching methods in innovative education. The problems of the development and use of productive educational technologies in the organization of the educational process are considered. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Using of a portable urine analyzer for remote health assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the practice of using portable biochemical analyzers as part of a remote monitoring system to assess the patient's condition. The theoretical foundations of the method of assessing the condition based on a complex of diagnostically significant indicators of the patient are described and a block diagram of the remote monitoring system is given. The investigation shows that diagnostics with the help of the used analyzer provides accuracy comparable to laboratory analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Information Security Problems in Electronic Management with Possible Solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The rapid development of the use of the Internet is laying the foundation for the development of digital communities. Their development and expansion involves individuals across the country (and around the world), but it also presents a number of challenges and opportunities for national governments. Take the e-government project as an example, where the flow of large amounts of documents, such as land documents, police records and other types of documents, electronically creates a security problem. In such organizations, each department is very important, so access to the network only by authorized people and access to information is a topical issue. The need to understand and implement information security ensures the safe operation of e-government organizations.

articleTitle: Investigation of spurious electromagnetic radiation in residential premises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses side electromagnetic radiation in residential premises, provides the results of measurements of their spectral components.

articleTitle: Development of Current Converters in the Power Supply Control and Management System Using Renewable Energy Sources Through Artificial Intelligence in the Sphere of Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the management of continuous processes of production, transmission, distribution and consumption of electrical energy, the accuracy and uniformity of elements and devices of the control system with the widespread use of primary means of current conversion are of great importance, since inadequate control and management of electricity and power leads to significant economic damage.

articleTitle: Application of transformer model architecture in the new drugs design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article proposes to use the artificial intelligence method, based on the technology of natural language modeling, namely the transformer model, to design new molecules. Language modeling allows the generation of molecules that have specific properties similar to molecules existing in the training set. Furthermore, the transformer model allows determining the appropriate context between the various elements formed in the molecular sequence. In this study, the molecules will be presented as SMILES, and five non-canonical pairs of each molecule will be created and trained in a transformer. Finally, the derived model is used to generate new molecules. The source code and attachments needed to teach the Transformer model are available at https://github.com/Mr-Shoxrux/Transformer-modeli/blob/main/Transformers-model.ipynb

articleTitle: Problems Of Building A Mathematical Model Of Epidemic Taking Into Account Vaccination
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the description and analysis of mathematical models of the spread of infectious diseases, the construction of a mathematical model of the spread of the COVID-19 epidemic, based on the models under consideration, numerical modeling of mathematical models of the spread of the disease with real statistical data and comparison of the mathematical models considered in this paper.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Groundwater Status Based on Geoinformation Systems and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article explores the components of a geoinformation modeling system designed to solve groundwater monitoring problems. Also, data sizes, types, and formats were analyzed. Methods of modeling geo filtration processes in the subsurface hydrosphere, obtaining and storing data on the state of the aquifer, their processing and analysis of the components of the GeoBase structure are considered.

articleTitle: Hydrogeological-Mathematical Model of Formation and Management of Resources and Quality of Fresh Underground Water of the Karakalpak Artesian Basin
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the problems of using groundwater resources of the Karakalpak artesian basin. The task of drawing up a geological and mathematical model of the operational resources of groundwater in the Karakalpak artesian basin for the rational use of fresh groundwater in the basin is set. This article discusses the problem of lack of fresh groundwater in the territory of the Republic of Karakalpakstan. A method of hydrogeological-mathematical model of exploitable groundwater resources for the correct use of fresh groundwater is proposed.

articleTitle: Human Body Wireless Temperature Sensor with Data Collection Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of the absence in practical medicine of simple, accessible, noise protection devices for Human body temperature monitoring with automatic registration of measurement results and the possibility of subsequent analysis initiated research in this direction. This research proposes investigation of temperature sensor data transmission using the Wireless Communication based on Bluetooth. Accordingly to this research analog Human Body Temperature Sensor is used, that why temperature sensor installed and to be processed by RN4870 Analog/Digital to Bluetooth signal converter module is considered.
