This module will transfer information from analog temperature sensor to Bluetooth terminal and by parallel to personal computer. All data stored in Terminal and Computer memory for further analysis.

articleTitle: Non-restoring QCA array divider using CIXOR functional gate
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, an improved design of non-restoring array divider is proposed based on the promising technology of quantum-dot cellular automata (QCA). The QCA design metrics such as delay, area and complexity for this array divider are enhanced, compared to previous-best works. This is because the compactness of the ‘controlled add/subtract’ (CAS) cells is increased using a QCA cell-interaction technique. Furthermore, we use an existing CIXOR gate and full adder for the design of the array divider, depending on the technique of the cell-interaction and clock-zone-based crossover.

articleTitle: Conceptual model of educational blockchain system for diploma indisputability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Diploma verification is a very important issue today. Blockchain technology offers mechanism that can prove diploma validity. Many solutions today are based on publishing diploma, generating cryptographic hash of a document, and publishing these credentials. This can only prove that this diploma document didn't suffer from any modification, but this does not proof that this diploma is valid. This paper presents conceptual model of future system based on blockchain technologies, that could perform diploma verification in a way to verify candidate educational path, and student diploma.

articleTitle: The Impact of Precipitation on Communication Failure in FSO
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Based on published statistically processed experimental data on quantitative characteristics of raindrops distribution by size, a formalized algorithm is presented and a calculation of communication failure in atmospheric optical transmission systems depending on the intensity of precipitation is performed.

articleTitle: Extraction informative features for making decision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article dedicated to extracting informative features with using similarity matrix. For extraction informative features, we search for hidden regularities from sociology database. In this way we need consider n-p full task and it will be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{n}$</tex> combinations. To solve this task, we use heuristic way. Extraction informative features reduces size of space (features) and help us make decision quickly. In the article we use invariant methods which extract informative questions of survey. Our survey were taken from korean, uzbek peoples and we obtained a result from this dataset.

articleTitle: Automation of Kpi Calculation for Leadership Personnel of Higher Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of automating the calculation of key performance indicators of university executives. The article considers indicators for evaluating the activities of teachers based on the electronic portfolio of pedagogical staff. A mathematical model and a generalized algorithm for calculating the KPI of pedagogical and executive staff are presented. As an example, the process of forming a report on the scientific and methodological activities of pedagogical staff is considered.

Author Keywords: evaluation of the effectiveness of executives

articleTitle: Predicting the activity and properties of chemicals based on RoBERTa
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Machine learning allows us to solve problems by learning big data. In recent years, machine learning has been widely used in various fields, including solving various problems in chemistry. Examples include in computational chemistry, in the discovery of new drugs and even in the prediction of the synthesis of substances. In this work, we propose BPE and RoBERT, the latest technologies in natural language processing, to predict the activity and properties of chemicals. The results obtained were compared with the results given by the ChemBERTa model.

articleTitle: An application of Gauss neutrosophic numbers in medical diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The obscure set is a useful mathematical tool for dealing with uncertainty. However, sometimes these theories may not be sufficient to model the vague and contradictory information encountered in the real world. To overcome this shortcoming, it has been suggested to work with neutrosophic set theory and neutrosophic numbers, which are useful in practical applications. In this paper, Gauss's concepts of neutrosophic numbers, cross-section, and parametric shape are defined. A decision-making algorithm using Gauss's neutrosophic number operations was developed and applied to the problem of classification of medical emblems.

articleTitle: Development of information database for providing data connection in work with the moodle cloud system for the credit training system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the above paper “Development of an information database to ensure data communication in the work with the Moodle Cloud system for the credit education system”, a special information database has been developed. A fast data search is proposed to ensure effective work with the information base. A connection has been established between the Moodle Cloud system and the information database, which provides all the necessary data for mastering knowledge of the subjects. The development process was carried out in the YII FRAMEWORK environment using a database based PHP application.

articleTitle: Numerical Algorithm for Calculation the Density of Harmful Substances in the Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article presents an algorithm for the numerical solution of a mathematical model that calculates the value of the density of harmful substances at different times and at different places of the region.

articleTitle: Building an information model of the main industries of the oil extraction enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Some failures in the use of modern information technology for the management of industrial complexes, associations, enterprises are associated with an insufficient assessment of the required composition of tasks, their complexity, priority, the possibility of implementing algorithms on information computing systems and the prospects for the practical use of the results of solving the problem. The article considers the construction of an information model of the main production with a discrete-continuous character, on the example of a fat and oil enterprise. For these purposes, we used the methods of graph theory for the qualitative description of the object, which then make it easier to switch to a quantitative analytical representation of the object model. The task of constructing an information model for the considered fat and oil production is reduced to such a choice of control parameters (operating modes of individual units) for the distribution of material and energy flows, at which the maximum possible production efficiency is ensured within the framework imposed on the system of production restrictions, which is assessed using the efficiency criterion, reflecting the degree of compliance of the obtained solutions with the set management goal. It is proposed to build an information management system for an oil extraction enterprise on the basis of interrelated sub-models, into which it is divided in the process of decomposition of the general model into a multi-level hierarchical system.

articleTitle: Superpixel Based Face Sketch Recognition Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Face sketch recognition is one of the main spheres of criminalistics science. Face sketch is created by artists and sends to recognize by current methods. Face sketch recognition process looks like to face recognition. However, in this process we need all landmarks of face. In this paper is proposed superpixel based face sketch recognition scheme. In addition, face landmarks are detected by Viola-Jones method and eigenfeatures are extracted from segmented face sketch by PCA.

articleTitle: Microservice Approach In Designing A Scalable Architecture On The Example Of An Electronic Invoice System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the context of constantly changing business tasks, the architecture of an information system based on a variety of microservices is a solution that allows you to quickly update and scale the system. The article describes the features, advantages, and tools of the microservice approach in the development of application architecture using the example of an electronic invoice information system. The structural scheme of the system implementation is given, the interactions of microservices are shown.

articleTitle: Program for Calculation of the Optimal Distribution of the Planned Amount of Gas on the Gas Supply Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article posed and solved the problem of developing a program for automating the calculation of the optimal distribution of the planned amount of gas over the gas network. The program for automating the calculation was tested on real production data of the functioning of the gas supply networks of the city of Samarkand according to the data of gas distribution station 1 and was written in C #.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Regulatory Mechanisms for the Distribution of Excitation in the Central Nervous System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, a mathematical model has been developed based on a system of nonlinear functional differential equations of a lagging type, using the method of regulating the regulatory mechanisms of interaction between the central nervous system and the main vital organs. The developed system of equations is simplified by the reduction and scaling method. There is an opportunity to develop new treatment tactics using mechanisms that regulate the interaction of the central nervous system and various organs, tissues and muscles of a person.

articleTitle: On One Method of Constructing a Decision Rule in Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The general problem of pattern recognition is to establish the theory and principles of building systems that share complex situations and events into classes. In this case, usually the number of possible situations in the classes is great and they are almost impossible to be remembered. The method of estimates' calculating contributes to a variety of scoring functions' building, which in turn, allows us to formulate and solve a wide class of multivariate data processing. In recent years more and more widely distributed methods of pattern recognition, in which the primary step is to calculate the balance of information and consideration of evidence. Based on the latest evidence being implemented, all further procedures until the distinction of classes or assign any object to one of the classes.

articleTitle: Approach for Estimating Distances Between Centers of Geometric Shapes based on Image Analysis and its Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A digital image is usually stored as a two-dimensional matrix consisting of numerical values of the intensity of each color; for example, Red-Green-Blue (RGB). This fact allows a possibility of manipulation of the image data, including making measurements based on the images of a moving object. This paper presents a new approach for estimating distances between the centers of geometric shapes based on image analysis. The algorithm is based on determining the parameters of the matrices - the number of rows and columns of graphic images of target plates and creating vectors of the sums of their values. As a result of such manipulations, peaks (maxima, minima) are formed that coincide with the centers of the squares and circles displayed on the target plates. These peaks are the coordinates of the target centers.

articleTitle: Understanding of Data De-identification: Issues of Relevance and Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents the process of data anonymisation and de-identification, the use of de-identification techniques as a means of data protection, and analyses de-identification and their relevance to the tasks they perform. There is also understanding re-identification risks and reasons to attempt a re-identification attacks. In addition, it also focuses on the actuality of solving the problem of data anonymisation and the problems of its implementation.

articleTitle: Cauchy Problem And Boundary- Value Problems For Multicomponent Cross-Diffusion Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the Cauchy problem and boundary value problems for multicomponent cross-diffusion systems, since studying the global solvability of the Cauchy problem and boundary value problems, obtaining estimates for solutions, studying the asymptotics of solutions for large values of time and the behavior of the free boundary without linearizing the equation is an important problem. Obtaining estimates for various types of solutions and the free boundary approximately or asymptotically makes it possible to numerically simulate the processes under study.

Author Keywords: Cauchy problem and boundary value problems population

articleTitle: Using of R parameter in a Massey-Omura protocol on elliptic curves
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Modern cryptography is based both on the classical areas of arithmetic and algebra, such as modular arithmetic, finite field theory, and on the most modern sections, including the theory and applications of elliptic curves, and anti-jamming coding. However, the development of computer technology leads to an increase in the stability of cryptosystems, that is, the length of keys. In this article, a method for increasing stability using parametric algebra without increasing the key length is illustrated by the example of the Messi-Omura algorithm based on an elliptic curve.

articleTitle: Parallel Computational Algorithms for Solving Boundary Value Problems for Two-Dimensional Equations of Parabolic Type
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers a parallel computation algorithm for the numerical solution of boundary value problems of the parabolic equation type. A schematic description of a parallel computation algorithm is given, which is based on the idea of an alternating direction scheme (longitudinally transverse scheme).

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Methods of Routing Flows in Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, methods of routing flows in telecommunication networks were considered. Models of routing flows with various optimization criteria were modeled. Computational experiments were carried out to estimate the average delay time of flows for single-path and multi-path routing. Areas of implementation efficiency of methods of routing flows are determined.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Automatic Text Editing Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mathematical support of the module, which helps to create queries based on intelligent communication systems, and formulates the main results that will help to formulate further research. Based on the request, the answer is transacted. These are key concepts in knowledge management. A single node of a communication scenario corresponds to a single node of intelligent communication systems.

articleTitle: Method of Detection and Elimination of Tracks of Attacks in the Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, stages of organizing attacks in the information system, identifying and eliminating traces of them have been studied. In Information Systems, the practical aspects of using attack detection techniques and attack detection techniques have been considered.

articleTitle: Application of distance learning in professional development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article examines the essence of distance learning, its state at the present stage, both in Uzbekistan and abroad. The advantages and disadvantages of this knowledge acquisition system are discussed, and the results of its application are analyzed.

articleTitle: Algorithm For Detecting Eye Diseases Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, a convolutional neural network and its modifications are algorithms for finding the best objects in terms of accuracy and speed. Therefore, in the diagnosis of eye diseases, a network of neurons was used, based on the principles of neocognitron and supplemented by training on the inverse error distribution algorithm. The article proposes a fully connected neural network with several architectures and several hidden layers, consisting of nonlinear neurons in each layer.

articleTitle: The Contemporary Language Studies with Corpus and Computer Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Corpus and computer linguistics are the fastest growing methods of the contemporary language studies. This article outlines the introduction to corpus and computer linguistics by defining the terms and giving a general overview of the corpus linguistics, describing the types of the corpus we have and the languages and novelties associated in this field. Writing this article is an excellent approach to me in gaining more and more eminence in this field. A large number of dictionary projects use corpus and computer linguistics. The software's features that support the creation of multilingual dictionaries and lexigraphy are also discussed. The software keeps on updating its old features to facilitate the users, and also adds entirely new features every now and then. CCS Concepts CCS →Applied computing→ Education → Collaborative learning

articleTitle: RENFIS-MA: A Recurrent Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System for Time Series Water Level Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is a well-known fact that improving time series prediction accuracy is an important and challenging issue. Exten-sive research has been conducted using soft-computing techniques to improve their prediction accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new methodology to predict time-series water-level, namely, recurrent error-based neuro-fuzzy inference system with moving average (RENFIS-MA). In particular, we used the adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system to build a prediction model. RENFIS-MA realizes that with the lagged variables of a time series feeding back network output-error to the input layer and moving-average of auto-regressive input making accurate predictions. It can identify the system's characteristics quite well and provides a new way to make time-series predictions. A comparative analysis of RENFIS-MA with four soft-computing models is conducted using the prediction of the water level of the river of Jamuna in Bangladesh. The trained networks are used for predicting both single-step and multiple-step ahead. In the simulation, two performance measures [root-mean-square error (RMSE) and prediction accuracy (Acc.)] demonstrate that the proposed method is more effective and accurate for prediction among all the compared models.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model and Algorithm of Simple Words and Simple Sentences in the Uzbek Language
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article developed a mathematical model of simple and complex words and phrases of the Uzbek language, which belongs to the family of Turkic languages. On the basis of the developed mathematical model, an algorithm is presented that generates simple and complex words and sentences.

articleTitle: Exact Solution of a Double Nonlinear Problem of Biological Population with Absorption and with Migration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: An exact solution of a nonlinear heat conductivity equation is constructed. Shows that the task in question when allows an accurate solution that allows you to establish nonlinear effects: a finite speed perturbation of distribution, a space localization and not distribution of the front are established.

articleTitle: Efficient Portfolios Computed via Moment-Based Bounding-approximations: Part II - DBFS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We develop and analyze a new second-order upper bound on the expectation of convex function of random variable with finite support. If the finite support is extended to infinite interval then we prove that the new upper bound tends to an upper bound already available in the scientific literature. We apply the upper bound as a second-order lower bounding approximation on the expected value of a concave utility function. We prove that the optimal solution of the approximate optimization problem yields mean-variance efficient portfolio. We illustrate how to use the resulting portfolios in practice by designing a daily trading strategy with stocks traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). Out of sample numerical results are presented for 29 years of daily trading for 24 stocks from NYSE.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology for Protecting a Software Package for Electronic Document Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper discusses the issues of protection of the software complex of mixed electronic document management by biometric authentication. The types of biometric authentication are analyzed and the advantages and disadvantages are shown. The disadvantages of document flow protection systems are described. A technique for searching for incorrect implementations when forming an open string is proposed.

articleTitle: The Internet in the Territory of Literature: Analysis of Blocks Dedicated to the Poetry of I. Yusupov
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, the issues of Internet technologies and the integration of literature are studied by analyzing the blocks dedicated to the poetry of I. Yusupov. The introduction part of the paper reveals the relevance of the topic and the technologies and tools used. The website, Facebook page, telegram channels and YouTube channel dedicated to the poetry of I. Yusupov were analyzed on the basis of the following criteria: rating by the number of visitors, attendance, distribution of visitors by age categories, by country, by operating systems, amount of publications, relative activity by content type, dynamics of number of subscribers and views and so on. Based on these analyzes, appropriate recommendations and conclusions have been developed.

articleTitle: Selecting a Suitable Initial Approximation Of Multi-Component Cross-Diffusion Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper deals with the modeling of the population and the choice of the initial approximation. The qualitative properties of multicomponent cross-diffusion systems were investigated, which made it possible to perform a numerical experiment depending on the values included in the system of numerical parameters. For this purpose, the constructed asymptotic solutions were used as an initial approximation.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Magnetoelastic Vibrations of Current Conductive Shells in the Non Stationary Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The mechanism of interaction of an elastic medium with the electromagnetic field is diverse and depends on the geometrical characteristics and physical properties of the body under consideration. In particular, this mechanism gets some specifics when considering the problems of thin plates and shells having anisotropic conductivity. The analysis of the stress state of the flexible orthotropic shells under the action of variable time and variable mechanical force on the external electric time on, based on mechanical and electromagnetic anisotropy. We investigate the effect of the thickness on the stress-strain state of anisotropic shell. Nonlinear deformation of current-carrying shells in the non stationary magnetic field is studied in ax symmetric statement. The results are indicative of the effect of shell thickness on the deformation and the need to take account of this factor in the calculation scheme.

articleTitle: Development of a Logo-Periodic Antenna in the Very High Frequency Band and Measurement of its Basic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, the authors have developed a log-periodic measuring antenna operating in the very high frequency range, and determined its main parameters. Measurements of the parameters of the developed antenna and similar antennas were carried out using the monitoring device and signal generators operating in the range from 350 MHz to 3 GHz, measurements showed that the average sensitivity of the developed antenna in comparison with the other types of antennas and the whip antenna is 15 dBm. When compared with the parameters of the HL-040 antenna, this indicator is practically constant 0.5 dBm in some frequency ranges up to 5 dBm, the developed antenna, by analogy, has a 3 times lower mass, and the geometric dimensions are up to 11 times miniature.

articleTitle: Development and research of a traffic management system based on DPI technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Modern telecommunication networks are improving every day, data transmission channels are improving, new transmission technologies are being developed. Based on these technologies, operators have introduced a variety of services that generate network traffic consisting of various types of data packets. Operators need to classify network traffic using new packet inspection technologies for efficient and accurate operation of the data network and service. Today, the classification of traffic data transmission network based on DPI technology is widely used in many countries, including ours. The development of new methods for classifying packets and their implementation in the data transmission network will give us a more accurate operation of the data transmission system.

articleTitle: Modeling the Gilbert Model for Communication Channels Based on Artificial Intellige
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, The Gilbert model of communication channel is modeled by using artificial intelligence methods. As well as, important aspects of the artificial intelligence to the Gilbert model are given. Furthermore, related research works are analyzed in this research work.

articleTitle: Identification module of the algorithms for calculating estimates
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a new algorithm for forming the systems of support sets on based partial precedents of given training set. The main idea of this algorithm is the selection of best features for object classification in the condition of increasing the number of features in the training set.

articleTitle: Visualization of the Results of Computing Experiments for Monitoring and Analysis of Filtration Processes In A Non-General Layer of Oil Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents the problem of oil filtration in a fragmented non-homogeneous porous medium layer, its mathematical model, and software for graphical visualization of numerical results for process analysis.

articleTitle: Development of ICT Creativity of Teachers of HEU’ With Helping Infographics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article covers the importance and theoretical-methodological analysis of developing ICT creativity of teachers of higher education institutions on the basis of infographics. Also, the concepts of ICT creativity, competence, creativity, infographic competence have been explained in detail and the role of ICT creativity in the teaching of module “Educational infographics” have been interpreted.

articleTitle: Coupled Dynamic Thermoelasticity Problem for Isotropic Bodies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers a numerical method for solving the one-dimensional and two-dimensional coupled dynamic boundary value problem of thermoelasticity. Discrete equations are compiled by the finite-difference method in the form of explicit and implicit schemes. The solution of the explicit schemes is reduced to the recurrence relations with respect to the components of displacement and temperature. Implicit schemas are solved by iteration.

articleTitle: Calculation of building dimensions in the method of composition fractal analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Some principles of the harmonic composition of the “Minor” Mosque in Tashkent, on the basis of modern methods of fractal analysis are tried to reveal in this article. The suggestions about using fractal dimension in researches which belong to architecture are given in this article. Fractal dimension is introduced as a coefficient which describes geometrically complex shapes, the capabilities of the method are reflected that the details are more important than complete drawn image for them. This research more developed a method for calculating grids of fractal analysis, it gives opportunity to check elements of architecture namely, the complexity of the architectural features of plan of the city, landscape, facade section, decorative pattern and building plan not only by measuring the complexity of the architectural features of building, but also by comparing the relationship among the architectural features.

articleTitle: Increasing the efficiency of network resources in ip networks based on fuzzy sets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article presents suggestions and recommendations for improving the efficiency of the use of network resources as a result of managing overhead information about the routing processes used in IP-based fuzzy-set networks.

articleTitle: Method and algorithms for measuring the signs of biomedical indicators of medical diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The analysis of the existing provisions of the development of electrophysiological research is given. The main attention is paid to electrophysiological diagnostic methods, analysis, measurement and processing of the electrocardiosignal. A technique for automatic medical diagnostics of electrophysiological parameters with the extraction of fragments during signal processing is proposed. At the same time, according to the established formal characteristics, they differ from each other according to the selected criterion or by a set of criteria with a given reliability. An algorithm for converting biosignals to isolate fragments and features for automatic diagnostics of patient conditions is proposed.

articleTitle: The Role of Processing Information in Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The development of the country's economy and the improvement of its management system cannot be done without information. Information consists of the continuous exchange of information between all sectors, industries, divisions of the national economy (from the workplace to the ministries) and between similar enterprises and organizations. With the growth of science and technology, the range of goods will increase, will be updated, the technical base of production will be enriched with modern and sophisticated machine systems, technological processes will intensify and become more complex, production specialization will expand, and so on. The article highlights the need and importance of information in marketing and analyzes the example of some companies. Moreover, the views of economic and marketing scientists are scrutinized in the article, resulting in more clear visualization of the role of information in marketing activities.

articleTitle: Development of a database of higher education process management information system based on the relational model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Current research is devoted to the process of creating a database of higher education process management information systems, creating tables regarding the activities of teacher, student, and curriculum. These are the main tables of the database, and developing relational connections between tables, and creating a data structure.

articleTitle: A simulation model of a cloud data center based on traditional networks and Software-defined network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article we have developed a simulation model in the Mininet environment for analyzing the operation of a software-defined network (SDN) in cloud data centers. The results of the simulation model of the operation of the SDN network on the Mininet emulator and the results of the simulation of the traditional network in the Graphical Network Simulator 3 emulator are presented.

articleTitle: Solving Fuzzy Transportation Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article proposes a method and an algorithm for solving a transport problem in a fuzzy environment. A fuzzy transport problem solved, a computational experiment is carried out, and results are obtained to illustrate the proposed method. This method is easy to understand and apply to find the optimal solution in fuzzy transport models of real problems.

articleTitle: Improving the efficiency of the motion determining of video objects used the contours of their binary images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The method of interframe coding of TV images is discussed in the article. It bases on the edge detection of video objects from their binary images on bit planes of pixel values. Such method of motion estimation allows us more efficiently encode video scenes with a high speed of movement of objects in real time.

articleTitle: Methods of recognizing texts in different images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In recent years, the separation of text from docu-ment images has been one of the most studied topics in the field of image analysis and optical character recognition. These parts of document images can be used for document analysis, content analysis, document retrieval, and more. To separate documents from images, we used a very simple method based on the FAST algorithm. First, we divided the image into blocks and checked their density in each block. Large blocks were marked as text, and there was less image area or noise. We then check to see if the blocks are locked so that we can separate the piece of text from the image. This method is very fast and versatile and can be used to recognize different languages, handwriting, and even images with noise and blur. Thus, this method helps to more clearly and comprehensively identify text from document images.

articleTitle: Formalization and algorithm of the problem of forecasting decisions made in self-government bodies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article examines the forecasting of previously adopted or proposed decisions in self-government bodies for a new governing body. For this, machine learning is applied based on a combination of gradient descent and stochastic gradient descent algorithms. As a priori data, generalized assessments of the direction of activity of self-government bodies and the corresponding decisions made or proposed by the experts are used.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling for optimizing the crops structure in the conditions of the Jizzakh region
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The nature of the rational use of land and water resources in the conditions of amelioration activity largely determines the potential suitability of each reclaimed territory for organizing the efficient production of a specific agricultural product. In this regard, the purpose of this work is to reveal the essence of the concept of “rational use of reclaimed territories”, to determine the key parameters of the efficiency of the use of reclaimed lands in the system of amelioration nature management. The results of optimization of the structure of sown areas and the placement of crops and clean fallow on arable land of different intensity of use are given in a differentiated manner for each agro-soil region, a project for the development of agricultural production in the near future.

Author Keywords: the allocation of cultivated areas and net fallows

articleTitle: Cascode Photoconverter With Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the developed cascode photoconverter with amplification that provides an extended range of stable operation, a high current gain and manufacturability of a transistor using the same type of transistor structures made on semiconductors with the same band gap. It is shown that a cascode photoconverter with amplification during photocurrent control operates stably at collector-emitter reverse voltage values 3–4 times higher than those of individual bipolar transistors.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Information Exchange through the Educational Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today in developing countries the education system is facing many problems which indicate that it needs serious reforms. A modern education system with a special focus on the development of individuality can bring together its diverse actors and improve its performance. For instance, the rapid advancement of technologies around us allows students to participate in the content generation process. Similarly, teachers and instructors can update their teaching materials with the help of new findings out of research and development activities. Current literature lacks well-designed studies to address the challenges that may arise in considering and delivering such an information exchange model. In this paper, we aim to deliver a mathematical model of information exchange through educational platforms.

articleTitle: Structural characteristics of a cavera at a small bubble stage of cavitation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article considers shock pulses arising from the closure of bubbles, depending on the structure of the cavitation cavity. Since the finely bubbly stage of cavitation is usually observed on the elements of hydraulic structures, the structural characteristics of the three stages of the appearance of cavitation are further investigated. Studies of the structure of cavitation require fixing the spatial pattern of the bubble zone. This is due to the need to use high-intensity luminous flux with ultra-short exposure. To solve these problems, a holography method using a ruby laser was used. To study the kinematics of a bubble near a wall, a ruby laser operated in the free-running mode during pumping with a duration of a total radiation pulse of up to 500 µs. Such a duration allows using a passive shutter to obtain up to three short light pulses (30 - 40 µs) of modulated Q-factor. The time intervals between pulses are measured on the screen of the storage oscilloscope and amount to 20 - 100 µs. The light pulse is transmitted to the oscilloscope by a coaxial photocell 30 FEK - 09.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Mathematical Model of Oscillation Processes of Spatially Loaded Rods with Account for Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Derivation of a mathematical model of oscillation processes of spatially loaded rods with account for temperature is considered in the paper. On the basis of the problem posed, using the generalized Hamilton-Ostrogradsky principle, the variations in kinetic, potential energy and work of external forces were calculated, and a nonlinear mathematical model of spatially loaded rods was derived, taking into account temperature. Based on the mathematical model, the resolving equations of spatially loaded rods with generalized natural initial and boundary conditions were derived.

articleTitle: Calculation of Synaptic Weights in Neuroexpert Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One of the main problems of the science of artificial thinking is the implementation of human thinking activities in any artificial devices. Examples of this are complex programs of various intellectual systems, expert systems, image recognition systems, and finally software systems based on artificial neural networks. These expert systems work with disclosed knowledge.

articleTitle: Problems of Building Global Corporate Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The globalization of the economy and the formation of the information society have led to the emergence of transnational network corporations and global corporate information systems (GCIS). Based on the analysis of their characteristics, a methodology for constructing GCIS is proposed, based on the principles of mutual correspondence of the structural and functional characteristics of transnational network corporations and GCIS, parallel and phased implementation of the creation and virtual modeling of their architectures. The system, structural and virtual models of GCIS architectures are considered. A functional virtual model of the hierarchical multilayer architecture of GCIS, which consists of six generalized layers: functional, operational, informational, integration, interface and infrastructural, is presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Multidimensional Automatic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, the problem of synthesizing an automatic control system for the extraction technological process is solved, which is a set of interconnected local control systems that implement the optimal settings of the upper level, directly controlling the technological parameters. A digital multi-connected system for controlling technological parameters of the process of extracting plant raw materials with liquefied carbon dioxide has been developed.

articleTitle: Implementation of speech processing algorithms based on Singular Value Decomposition and Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses a new approach to processing speech commands based on Singular Value Decomposition and Hidden Markov model. Using this approach in real conditions has reduced the computational load on the processor and the recognition accuracy of speech command increased.

Author Keywords: Short Time Fourier Transform. Vector Quantization

articleTitle: Complementary Cascode Current Source
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the developed complementary cascode current source using light-emitting diodes devices infocommunication systems for transmitting information and electrical lighting. It is shown that the performance on efficiency coefficient of the proposed composite cascode current source with a change in supply voltage and load resistance in the wide band is more than twice the efficiency of the closest analogue.

articleTitle: Conversion of the Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Algorithm Based on Elliptic Curve Equations to Elliptic Curve Equations with Private Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The advantage of cryptographic systems based on elliptical curves over traditional systems is that they provide equivalent protection even when the key length used is small. This reduces the load time of the processors of the receiving and transmitting devices. But the development of computer technology leads to an increase in the stability of the cryptosystem, that is, the length of the keys. This article presents a method for converting elliptic curve equations to hidden parameter elliptic curve equations to increase stability without increasing key length.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Test Signal from the Energy Spectrum of a Real Digital Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of synthesis of a test signal from the energy spectrum of a real digital signal is theoretically considered. The formula for the energy spectrum is obtained. From the above theoretical calculations, it follows that periodically stationary pulse random processes of higher order and the continuous part of the energy spectra of these processes are the same, and the discrete components of the spectrum of the simulating pulse random process are located mc times more often on the frequency axis than the discrete components of the periodically stationary pulse random process of the first order.

articleTitle: Types and features of data exchange in microcontrollers through various interfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The process of information exchange with microcontrollers and various devices is carried out through communication interfaces installed between them and accepted around the world. Accepted interfaces are divided into two types, namely, serial and parallel transmission interfaces. Sequence-based interface is the most commonly used communication interface. provides the ability to compare them, to study their main differences and features, to choose the optimal interface based on the state of data transmission. The paper provides information on the types of interfaces that work on a sequential basis and the principle of their operation.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing Security Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: in this paper focuses on development of cloud computing, privacy security issues have become increasingly prominent, which is of concern to industry and academia. We review the research progress on privacy security issues from the perspective of several privacy security protection technologies in cloud computing. First, we introduce some privacy security risks of cloud computing and propose a comprehensive privacy security protection framework.

articleTitle: NaCl Concentration and Water Temperature Influence on the Rayleigh Wing by Four Photon Polarized Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The hypersonic lattice resulted from the interaction of reference wave with the scattering medium leads to the anizotropic scattering nonlinear cubic susceptibility modulation and the formation of maxima in the Rayleigh wing displaced from each other to the Brillouin frequency in the range from -2 cm-1 to 2 cm-1.With the increase of NaCl concentration and water temperature it is observed the growth of water adiabatic compressibility and hence the increase of Brillouin threshold and the decrease of the anizotropic scattering nonlinear cubic susceptibility modulation degree. With the modulation degree decrease the side maxima amplitude deminishes and is not registrated by the set. This result in the Rayleigh wing narrowing obtained by four photon polarized spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Neural networks for medical image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article focuses on the methods of segmentation of images of the human abdomen, the main emphasis is on the methods of segmentation based on neural networks. The structure of neural network architectures, which are now widely used for medical imaging, has been researched and compared based on experimental studies.

articleTitle: Mathematical and Information Model of Electronic Document Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical and information model for the management of electronic documents in electronic document management systems has been developed. The model is built on the set of data (electronic documents) in the system and the events and properties of the electronic document that represent their relationship. To solve the problem of optimization, it is noted that the coefficients of the equation tend to minimize the function f(x<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i,j</inf>,y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i,j</inf>,R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>) in the constraints of electronic document values, and an important factor in obtaining from the database in the management of electronic document management system is the value of this information and its cost. The hierarchical view of the management structure of electronic document management systems is expressed and their mutual information exchange is proposed in the form of an information model (table).

articleTitle: Monitoring of Development Of Information And Management Competencies Of Masters Of Technical Higher Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article presents the results of an ascertaining experiment on problems in the field of development of information and management competencies of masters of Technical higher educational institutions. The author analyzes the effectiveness of the process of development of information and management competencies, identifies factors that contribute to improving the development of masters of of Technical higher educational institutions for future teaching activities. In the article the diagnostics of revealing readiness of development of information and management competencies on a measuring instrument (indicators) is given. The quality of education was monitored, on the basis of which indicators for the following evaluation objects were developed and tested: educational activities; extracurricular activities; the quality of the conditions for ensuring the educational process. Their use in the process of experimental and experimental work is also considered. The results of the determination of readiness of development of information and management competencies on combined levels of assessment are summarized.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Calculation Procedure of Tax Burden with Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research paper studies the tax policy of Uzbekistan, specifically the issue of tax burden, the essence of tax burden indicator and different approaches of calculating it. In this article, international experience of using digital technologies to improve taxation system and the situation of Uzbekistan in this matter are proposed. Analyzing different sources in this theme, conclusion and suggestions are given.

articleTitle: CRN and 5G based IoT: Applications, Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes CRN and 5G-based IoT applications, the challenges and opportunities in their implementation. Initially, the relevance of the use of cognitive radio networks and 5G technologies in the implementation of IoT applications was revealed for today's science and technology. Then, the concepts of cognitive radio and cognitive IoT, their possibilities are explained. The IoT architecture based on CRN and 5G is presented and the principles of operation are explained. The application of CRN and 5G-based IoT in Smart Home, Smart City, Smart Grid, Smart Medicine, Smart Transportation, Environmental and other applications was analyzed. Also, the main problems in the implementation of CRN and 5G-based IoT: hardware design problems, rapid data analysis problems, spectrum resource management problems, Standardization link problems related to network construction and location, energy efficiency and security problems, as well as potential opportunities to solve them were analyzed.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Results of Algorithms for Dilated Cardiomyopathy and Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, has been developed a convolutional neural network algorithm based on Echo to automatically classify cardiomyopathy. This algorithm allows to classify dilated (DCM) cardiomyopathy and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with an accuracy of 98. 2%. With the improvement of this approach, it is possible to develop an intelligent system and expert systems that will help to make decisions aimed at early detection, classification and diagnosis of symptoms of heart diseases.

articleTitle: Development Trend of Modern Satellite Television
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Satellite communication systems have been actively developing, which is primarily due to a decrease in the overall weight, price characteristics of the spacecraft themselves and, as a consequence, the cost of deploying and operating the most expensive component of satellite communication systems, their orbital groupings. These factors make modern satellite communication systems more and more accessible, and the increasing volume of transmitted information determines their increasing demand.

articleTitle: The role of Artificial Intelligence in Education: Current Trends and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today's education plays a vital role in an individual and a society's development. This research have been discovering and developing the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the educational field and coming up with potential applications that have not been known before. Artificial Intelligence explores the new possibilities of innovation in educational technology. Today, artificial intelligence becomes the core element of the modern education system and a basic tool to get competitive advantages of the market. In this paper, we highlight the applications of artificial intelligence in education, existing tools and applications, the latest market and research trends, opportunities, pitfalls, and current limitations of AI in education. In particular, the work reviews the various applications of AI in education including classroom monitoring and recommendation systems, intelligent tutoring, sentiment analysis, students' retention, and drop out the prediction and student grading and evaluations. For this detailed review study, we analyzed various works of related domains, sub-domains like big data in education, educational data mining (EDM), and learning analytics. In this work, Educational applications are analyzed from different perspectives. One side gives a comprehensive depiction of the platforms and tools developed as the product of research work. On the other hand, it recognizes the limitations, potential challenges, and opportunities for future enhancement, and this provides a baseline for future research in the e-learning domain.

articleTitle: Application of the algebraic cryptanalysis method to the Kuznyechik encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper examines the application of the algebraic cryptanalysis method to the Kuznyechik encryption algorithm. The algebraic properties of reflections are studied, algorithms for the formation of a system of relative algebraic equations the formation of equations representing rounds are developed. When expressed using the proposed methods, it was found that the number of unknowns in the system of equations representing the 8-round Kuznyechik encryption algorithm is ≈2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">55</sup>, and the required memory size is ≃ 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">62</sup>.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity and Information War
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the 21st century, information is becoming the most powerful weapon of the forces fighting for world domination. The amount and relevance of information available to the parties of confrontation have a direct impact on their combat capability. Thus, it is possible to influence the enemy's combat capability by destroying their equipment, infrastructure and manpower, or it is possible to influence his information exchange processes or introduce own information into the enemy's information systems. Consequently, the main goal of an information war is to influence the enemy's information in order to undermine his combat capability, as well as to protect own information from enemy influence. This article revealed the main forms of information warfare, such as cyberattack, infoagression, disinformation, propaganda and their specificity in the modern world.

articleTitle: Analysis of disconnected neural networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article made an analysis of disconnected neural networks. The main concepts of neural networks, their characteristics, features, areas of application, the main directions of application of neural networks, the structure of neural networks, the main types of neural networks, existing problems in the field of neural networks are given. The concept of a neural network algorithm is given. The solution of the analysis of disconnected neural networks in the form of basic mathematical expressions is shown. Algorithms for searching for the extremum of secondary optimization functionals are shown.

articleTitle: Load Balancing Method in Smart City Networks based Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A significant amount of research work carried out on traffic management systems, but Load balancing is still an active research topic due to the emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and Software Defined Networking (SDN). The integration of these technologies will facilitate the techniques for better decision making and achieve urban growth.

articleTitle: Modeling Flow of Smart City Network: Review and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Diverse applications of IoT technology generate the expected data traffic that is generated by different networks. Diverse traffic requires the most suitable mathematical apparatus to create an adequate model. Some traffic models are more correctly described based on fractal analysis methods. Application flow models that approximate various distributors with both “light tails” (Gauss, Poisson distribution) and “heavy tails” (Pareto, Weibul distribution, lognormal distribution). Self-similar traffic models are widely used to describe traffic in packet-switched networks. The degree of self-similarity of traffic can be determined by various methods. Traffic samples generated by IoT devices are considered: traffic model for a wireless sensor network (WSN) based on a Gaussian distribution; ON / OFF WSN traffic model for tracking randomly and linearly moving targets; IoT traffic models with distributions over a limited time interval; self-similar model of aggregated traffic on the WSN gateway.

articleTitle: Interconnection of Performance Indicators and Reliability of Data Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The concepts of a data communication system (DCS), as well as the classification and various network architectures, types and hierarchies of network nodes, characteristics and analysis of their development are discussed in this article. The modern element base based on the use of large-scale integrated (LSI) circuits, very large-scale integrated (VLSI) circuits and microprocessor sets (MPS) is considered, which can significantly increase the efficiency of systems - increase productivity and reliability, expand the functionality of systems, reduce weight, dimensions and power consumption. The main directions of work to improve the reliability of DTS are given, their advantages and disadvantages are shown. The main directions of improving the technical, operational characteristics of DCS and technical means by improving the maintainability indicators, the main tasks of ensuring the testability and diagnosing DCS are considered. The graph of the states of the system with built-in control (BIC) is given and on the basis of the graph an expression for the availability factor of the system with built-in control is obtained.

articleTitle: Application of Telecommunication and Geoinformation Support of Groundwater Monitoring in Irrigated Agricultures Zones
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper has presented the system of regular automation monitoring of changes in the state of groundwater under the influence of natural and techno genic factors, directly related organizationally and methodically to solving the problems of forecasting and managing resources, groundwater quality and regime. Study the operation of irrigation systems operation services and reclamation inspections, which have a dense network of points of irrigation hygrometry, wells and piezometers, do not allow to quickly and timely assess the land reclamation state and make an organizational (monitoring) and technical decision. Automation of this service based on modern information and communication and GIS technologies allowed, firstly, to significantly reduce the time of collecting and analyzing information for making operational management decisions, and secondly, to significantly increase reliability, excluding the human factor, and also: to carry out visualization in the form of digital data and maps on the level, chemical composition and physical properties of groundwater; to assess the condition of the flooded territories, as well as perform a comprehensive assessment of these territories; based on the use of modern technical and software to integrate, analyze and provide information support for managerial decision-making to prevent negative consequences.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and software package for calculating the balance of information flow
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article proposes to improve the efficiency of methods for calculating the flow balance and mathematical modeling of geofiltration processes in hydrogeological systems. In the course of the research, the methods of system analysis, calculation of the flow balance and mathematical modeling, numerical methods and algorithms were used. Groundwater regime - the procedure for measuring the change over time in the quantity and quality of these waters in the natural and water management environment. The balance of groundwater quantitatively expresses a complex process of the formation of these waters, while it requires reliable knowledge about the size and sequence of the impact on the studied waters of such processes as infiltration of precipitation, irrigation water from the surface, evaporation from the groundwater level, overflow vertical, horizontal flow in the aquifer, and genetic relationships between groundwater and surface water.

articleTitle: Statistical models for forecast of “quality of the day” for the category of facilities of meteo-dependent people
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper the questions of constructing three types of statistical models for forecasting the “quality of the day” for the category of facilities of meteo-dependent people with problems of the cardiovascular system are considered. A comparative analysis of the obtained statistical models is carried out according to two criteria: adequacy, computational costs.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Effective Use of Scientific and Technical Innovations in the field of Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article proposes scientific news, scientific proposals and recommendations on the features of effective use of scientific and technical innovation in the field of information technology.

articleTitle: A Novel Clustering protocol for Optimal Node Placement in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Over the past years, there have been several issues related to WSN. In this research, we analyzed the most advanced aspects like important characteristics, research parameters, energy conversation, network lifetime, practical issues and various challenges with Clustered wireless sensor networks. We propose clustering-based routing protocol for Wireless sensor network (CBWSN) to reduce energy consumption and improve energy efficiency through clustering and routing algorithms. The basic idea is to periodically update the network topology and select the node with larger degree and high residual energy as the cluster head to be responsible for data aggregation and transmission. With the nodes moving, joining, and choosing the optimal clustering radius, the energy load of the whole network can be evenly distributed to each sensor node, which can significantly prolong the network lifetime. Extensive simulations show that CBWSN is more energy-efficient than the existing protocols.

articleTitle: Machine learning methods as a tool for diagnostic and prognostic research in cardiovascular disease
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) methods are the main tool of artificial intelligence, the use of which makes it possible to automate the processing and analysis of big data, to reveal hidden or non-obvious patterns on this basis, and to extract new knowledge. The review presents an analysis of scientific literature on the use of ML methods for diagnosing and predicting the clinical course of coronary heart disease. Provides information on reference databases, the use of which allows you to develop models and validate them (European ST-T Database, Cleveland Heart Disease database, Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis, etc.). The advantages and disadvantages of individual ML methods (logistic regression, support vector machines, decision trees, naive Bayesian classifier, k-nearest neighbors) for the development of diagnostic and predictive algorithms are shown. The most promising ML methods include deep learning, which is implemented using multilayer artificial neural networks. It is assumed that the improvement of models based on ML methods and their introduction into clinical practice will help support medical decision-making, improve the effectiveness of treatment and optimize health care costs.

articleTitle: Extracting Linguistic Properties to Predict Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The ability to determine the online reviews from consumers is essential for properties manager and owner in order to enhance their quality of service, consumer loyalty and revenue. The proliferation of data in online platforms established the need to explore the information within it and creates usable insight for businesses. This study aims to analyze reviewer behavior and style of individual customer reviews. Each factor is analyzed toward the overall customer rating to determine the writing characteristics of the reviewers based on the score they gave on the review platform. The reviews are gathered from Traveloka.com with location boundaries in Bandung Raya that encompass Bandung city, Cimahi city, West Bandung Regency, and Bandung Regency. The research uses multiple linear regression analysis to determine the effect of the linguistic behavior factor. This study assessed whether linguistic properties play a significant part in evaluating customer overall satisfaction. The results of the research finding show that linguistic properties play a part in predicting customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Model of automation of growth carp fish pond warm-water economy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the formation of hatchery hatchery line structures, classification of cages for growing into: stationary (used in bodies of water characterized by a constant water level); floating cages for growing fish (they are not afraid of water level fluctuations, they have proven themselves when used in almost any type of water body). Cages are a frame covered with net material placed in water in which fish are bred. The cage can be floating on floats or submerged completely in water on stilts. In other words, a cage is a part of a reservoir enclosed by net material from the sides and from below. Unlike ponds, cages are a real “designer” that can be “assembled” for specific tasks. There are many options for using cages. From a full-system cage economy to a narrow direction within the framework of a classic pond economy. In cage farms, the main equipment is cages themselves. There are many classifications of cages / 1 /. One of the most common subdivides cages for growing into: stationary (for reservoirs with a constant water level) and floating. Floating boats, in turn, are divided into three groups: cradles on pontoons, sectional cages and floating autonomous collapsible cages PARS. According to the intended purpose, fish hatcheries can be divided into feeding, growth, fry, larvae, spawning, and winter ones.

Author Keywords: growth carp fish pond warm-water economy

articleTitle: Traffic and throughput for 4G packet core networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The expansion of 4G/LTE network and the high demands on its services require operators to invest in network planning. The main goal for operators is to have a network that has optimal cost and still can deliver different services. The core network, despite its importance, didn't get the same amount of attention. Many network planners who based their planning on traffic didn't focus on traffic generation, but rather used estimated or measured traffic values. In our article, we presented a network planning tool that deals with the core network of LTE taking into consideration realistic traffic parameters.

articleTitle: New Approach to developing efficient NIDPS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays the Internet is very massive and the need for a system to protect the networks from being attacked becomes very important. One of the main goals of studying pattern matching techniques is their significant role in realworld applications, such as the intrusion detection systems branch. The purpose of the network attack detection systems NIDS is to protect the infocommunication network from unauthorized access. This article provides an analysis of the categorizing Internet traffic which called packet classification and fuzzy matching methods, and discusses a new implementation of the classic Aho-Corasick pattern matching algorithm at the hardware level. The proposed approach to the implementation of the Aho-Corasick algorithm can make it possible to ensure the efficient use of resources, such as memory and energy.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Analysis of Automatic Speech Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Recently broad steps have been made in the field of automatic speech recognition by applying the hidden Markov model, and different end-to-end deep learning models. The automatic speech recognition system is a conversion of human speech into the text or control signal by the means of smart methods and performs an essential part in multiple biometric authentication systems and voice-controlled automation systems. In this study, we review the benefits and limitations of the hidden Markov model-based design and end-to-end approaches, which are connectionist temporal classification-based, recurrent neural network-transducer, and attention-based. Their respective advantages and disadvantages and the possible future improvement of the end-to-end approaches are finally pointed out. We reported every factor that potentially influences the accuracy of automatic voice recognition. As a result, we believe this paper will serve as a suitable starting point for academics interested in automatic speech recognition.

articleTitle: Mathematical representation of the problem of forming the lesson schedule of higher education institutions in the credit module system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Automation of scheduling in a higher education institution is an important problem. Mathematically, this is an integer programming problem. One of the most pressing issues in the study of students' agendas and workload is the issue of faster recovery of children's ability to work as a result of a combination of physiological balance in the body through various activities - rest, nutrition, sleep, etc. Therefore, it is important to take into account not only the resources but also the physiological capabilities of students in the formation of the schedule. Mathematical method of schedule is a most important process in develop a good schedule. In this article, preview automation schedule process in example TUIT credit systems.
