Also the research presents information and limitations used in the preparation of schedules, it reviews the existing software for automatic scheduling.

articleTitle: A Smart Traffic Controlling System Using Auxiliary Sensors with Deep Learning and Its Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The traffic jam is a severe problem in modern cities, and many researchers tried to reduce the pain by optimizing the traffic system and traffic participants. This paper introduces a hardware system to optimize the time management of the crossings to improve the overall efficiency of the city's transportation. After installing this system, redundant seconds will be eliminated, and more time will be given to pathways that are in congestion. We separate our research into two parts. The aim of conducting the auxiliary sensors of light gates is to measure the accurate speed of vehicles passing by and counting the cars passing by for one lane for the calibration of the camera identification, in the form of model simulation. The detector algorithm uses Faster-RCNN as the base with real-time image processing to detect the existence of cars. The algorithm provides the numerical results of the amounts of vehicles. And the auxiliary light gate measures accurately the speed of the vehicles. The method is sufficient for a traffic lighting system with also elementary principles that reduces the cost of massively producing the system integrated chips. With the implementation of this system, the efficiency of a city will be promoted. Finally, we use the simulation method to get the total time of the traffic flow with and without modifying the time interval and periods of green lights, and the result shows the modification has a positive effect of reducing the total passing time of the cars.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model and Methods for Filtering an Email Message
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes a mathematical model based on diffusion and methods for filtering an email message. A generalized block diagram of the filtration system is studied. The methods of protecting the mail server from spam are analyzed.

articleTitle: Perspectives Of Using Of OWC In Digital Storytelling Content Delivering In Museums
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Content management in education, advertisement, business, and even science today it's the main part of visitor attraction. Using the intellectual integrated information technologies in providing visitor-oriented content helps to erase the borders between nations, languages, and mentality. The key to explaining something to a person is in words and symbols, that is how our ancestors shared their knowledge. Using speech humans controlling their minds, interact, and sensing the mood of each other. This paper introduces perspectives and possibilities of using parts of Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) technology for museums. The proposed scheme of network and software architecture is described in the text.

articleTitle: Conditions for the development of students' information competence in the aspect of the development of distance learning in the humanities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes the current issues of the use of new information and communication technologies in the teaching of humanities, in particular history in higher education. Due to the difficulties encountered with mastering the educational material in distance learning, there was a need to find new methods of teaching humanities in higher education using new information tools and methods. Special attention is paid to the methods of distance learning, their advantages are considered. The necessity of informatization of the higher education process in the formation of an information society is also justified.

articleTitle: Analysis of existing standards for information security assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the existing standards for assessing the state of information security, which provides a classification and comparative analysis of standards for assessing the state of information.

Author Keywords: Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies (COBIT)

articleTitle: Railway Monitoring System Simulation on the Sensors Stream Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Observing advancements in safety systems of the railway, it can be seen that the past researches have done a remarkable contribution in finding and creating techniques to remove noise and vibration caused by wheel and rail friction on the railroad tracks. As high-speed trains grow in popularity, the safety monitoring system is becoming an integral part of the railway network to decrease the effect of the vibration and noise, stemming from train pass-by, on our welfare and livelihood, making it a significant study topic. With the current modern technologies such as AI and Internet of Things (IoT), we have now, those advances can be further developed close to perfection as AI, IoT technologies have a huge capability to deliver security, safety, and working efficacy in railway overpasses, underpasses and whole railroad arrangements. The present study proposes a railroad security and safety controlling solution powered by the Internet of Things (IoT) to provide a synchronized evaluation and impost of the status of operation efficiency along with safety and security in railway overpasses, underpasses and the well-being of residents living in areas surrounding the railroad infrastructure.

articleTitle: Linguistic functionality of Uzbek Electron Corpus: uzbekcorpus.uz
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the structure and its linguistic annotation for building Uzbek Corpus. Linguistic annotation, metadata and corpus manager as formal-functional model of the corpus are important for usage for many purposes. The fact that the platform allows users to address language and literature issues, use it online. The Uzbek corpus based on structural and sub corpus models, which partially represented in this paper, is going on process to develop Uzbek language technology.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Calculating Vegetation Indices NDVI for Time Series of Landsat 8 Multisspectral Satellite Images on Google Earth Engine Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: There is a collection of LandSat8 images and a set of functions written on the Google Earth Engine platform for calculating the average value of the vegetation indices NDVI. The article describes an algorithm and a fragment of the program code for calculating NDVI indices for time series of multispectral satellite images LandSat8 in the Earth Engine cloud platform. The result of the average value of the vegetation indices for the time series is presented as a curve of the line of changes for 2020–2021.

articleTitle: Indicators of Efficiency of Synthesis of Access Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, a scientific and methodological basis is developed for the further development of formal models and methods for the construction and operation of these access control systems, reflecting the features of the functioning of computer systems in conditions of an information conflict and based on their assessment of the efficiency of synthesis of these systems.

articleTitle: Big Data Technologies in Transport Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article shows the architecture of an intelligent transport system. The objects and standards of the intelligent transport system have been studied. The problems of the intelligent transport system are analyzed and a solution using Big Data technology is proposed.

articleTitle: A hybrid rat-race coupler whose dimensions are reduced with the help of artificial lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: For the purpose of miniaturization of the coupler, a variant of artificial transmission lines consisting of LCL elements is proposed. Their use made it possible to achieve a 4.3-fold reduction in the area. The proposed scheme for constructing a coupler was theoretically and experimentally investigated. The results agree with each other. The differences between the traditional and compact scheme are mainly an increase in losses by 0.6 dB and a narrowing of the band by 1.6 times.

articleTitle: Performance Characteristics of Fiber Optical Lines and Diagnostic Techniques for Optical Fiber Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers methods for assessing the reliability of FOCL during operation and analyzes methods for diagnosing an optical fiber cable. The main factors affecting the reliability parameters of optical cables and leading to signal losses in optical cables are presented. Reliability indicators are listed. A calculation method for assessing the reliability of digital information transmission is described. The analysis of the calculation of the service life of the optical fiber methods for testing fiber-optic equipment and cables, the procedure for checking an optical fiber, and checking a fiber-optic communication line using an optical time domain reflect meter are shown.

articleTitle: Crossover design based on microstrip structural elements
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The size of the crossover was reduced using synthesized structures that have smaller dimensions and similar characteristics to conventional segments. The results of modeling and experiment are also presented, which allowed us to compare the results and determine that the proposed design is working. At the same time, the dimensions due to the structures were reduced from 5776 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 2112 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: The role of adaptive filters in the recognition of speech commands
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses adaptive methods for filtering noise affecting speech commands in real operating conditions. The method of adaptive NLMS filters is proposed for speech command recognition. The recognition accuracy of speech command has increased due to the use of the NLMS method. Digital signal filters are used to eliminate interference in speech recognition systems. However, the effectiveness of the use of classical filtering algorithms for speech signals with a complex appearance is very low. In such cases, the use of adaptive filters can meet the system requirement. Flexible filters use Least Mean Square (LMS), Normalized LMS (NLMS) algorithms to eliminate noise. These algorithms differ from each other in Global Signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR). If the GSNR is good, this algorithm is more useful for the system. Using these algorithms, the accuracy of the speech recognition system was found. Thus, we conclude that adaptive filtering algorithms are more efficient than classical filtering algorithms.

articleTitle: Techniques and methods of BLACK BOX identifying vulnerabilities in web servers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, we analyzed the definition of vulnerability in a web server using the black box method. The article shows the main problems of scanning web applications. The BLACK BOX technique that defines vulnerabilities in web servers is analyzed: equivalence classes, boundary values, decision table, pairwise testing, state transition diagram, use cases.

articleTitle: Online Registration and monitoring system of patients with diabetes in clinics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article examines some of the shortcomings and problems encountered in the process of informatization of the medical field. The structure of the database was developed in the creation of medical information systems, and a system of online registration and monitoring of patients with diabetes was developed. This system is designed for hospitals and serves to prevent endocrine diseases, their early detection, registration and clinical care in the introduction of a healthy lifestyle in the population.

articleTitle: Analysis of methods and algorithms for feature extraction of biosignals of muscle activity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses biosignals of muscle activity, electromyographic signals and methods for their analysis. In the course of the study, a new approach was proposed for the feature extraction of biosignals of muscle activity. Based on the proposed approach, muscle biosignals were recorded and processed during training athletes.

articleTitle: Directional Coupler with Small Physical Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper highlights the problem of the physical dimensions of directional couplers operating at low frequencies. The design of a compact coupler is considered. The results of modeling and experiment are presented. A comparative analysis of the calculation results with the experimental results is made. The proposed design was obtained by using artificial lines placed in place of the segments, which made it possible to reduce the size of the device at a frequency of 0.9 GHz by 77.5%.

articleTitle: Selection of Building Material Using the Decision-Making System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today, intelligent technologies are widely used in the building materials industry to further deepen economic reforms and accelerate the development of the industry, develop new modern building materials and expand their range. Therefore, the joint use of intelligent technologies to create hybrid intelligence, including evolutionary algorithms and software tools that increase the efficiency of solving construction problems, remains an open question. The article examines these problems, current trends and the possibilities for their solution. In addition, a more complete framework has been proposed for intelligent decision-making systems (IDMS) with the building information model.

articleTitle: Study of the Spectrum of Side Electromagnetic Radiations of Video Interface DVI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents the results of experimental studies of the spectra of side electromagnetic radiation of the DVI video interface, depending on the screen resolution and the monitor frame refresh rate.

Author Keywords: frequency spectrum of side electromagnetic radiation

articleTitle: Developing a model and algorithm for decision support in self-government bodies using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of developing a model and algorithm for assessing the state and supporting decision-making in self-government bodies using a neural network of machine learning. A multi-layer direct propagation neural network is constructed as a neural network. The neural network has three inputs, the hidden layer has two neurons and one output. The training sample consists of parametric assessments of educational activities, the social environment and the state of crime in local governments. The dependent parameter in the sample consists of generalized expert assessments of self-government bodies, in numerical form. A model and algorithm of the decision support process using a multilayer neural network of direct propagation perceptron are constructed. Based on the constructed model and the proposed algorithm, the weight coefficients of neurons are calculated and a linear function is constructed to support decision-making. Using this model, a generalized expert assessment is determined for the new self-government body in numerical form, which is interpreted as a proposed solution for improving the condition of the object.

articleTitle: Optimization the indicators of quality of service
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A method for determining the optimal value of indicators of the quality of customer service is proposed. The method is based on minimizing the generalized indicator - reduced costs. This indicator takes into account, on the one hand, the interests of the company, on the other hand, the interests of service users. The results obtained allow us to select an indicator of the quality of customer service and its normalized value for the provision of various services.

Author Keywords: system of combined method of service
cost of lost time of customers and company income

articleTitle: Optimization of the Structure of Telecommunication Networks by the Method of Penalty Function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of optimization of the physical structure of the telecommunication network with a multilevel structure by the methods of the penalty function is solved. The use of the penalty function method made it possible to simplify the optimization task and determine the optimal structure of the telecommunication network according to the criterion of network-wide costs.

articleTitle: Filtering algorithms for speech signals in MAxk TLAB
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Typically, speech signals interfere with other types of signals. In cases where noise performance is enhanced, its continuation can be modified, analyzed, or the results of speech evaluation changed. In other cases, such as the analysis of noisy recordings for forensic purposes or the restoration of audio recordings in archives, the task of filtering the signal from noise are the main purpose of the research work. Therefore, the development of methods to filter the signal from noise is a very topical area of research.

articleTitle: QCA based Content Addressable Memory Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Promising nanotechnology, Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA), is a possible platform for implementing future chip production. This paper presents systematic reviews about the QCA-based memories and during review we also propose a new QCAdesign of CAM cell with low complexity. Structural analysis using the QCADesigner simulation tool is carried out to evaluate the proposed designs.

articleTitle: Nonsmooth Optimal Control Problem For Model Of System With Delay Under Conditions Of Uncertainty External Influence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers a mathematical model of control system with delay under conditions of uncertainty external influence. Optimization problem for nonsmooth terminal functional in the minimum type is researched. The necessary and sufficient conditions of optimality are obtained. Construction algorithm of optimal control is suggested.

articleTitle: Some Ways to Solve the Problem of Stoxastic Optimization Direct
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: this paper focuses on relatively simple direct search methods for solving the optimization problem of minimizing a loss function L = Z(θ) subject to the parameter vector 0 lying in some set 0.

articleTitle: Implementation of the R-Function for virtual environment objects of the simple shapes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article offers with the implementation of this work, ie the creation of a national virtual university platform, geometric modeling of the design of exteriors, interiors and characters in the field of information technology on the basis of 3D technologies. We know that visualization uses geometric splines and methods of constructing polygonal grids. The project proposes new methods in the geometric modeling of 3D objects, ie the constructive logic-algebraic R-function method (RFM). This method allows you to depict 3D objects at high complexity.

articleTitle: The marine information system uses miniature Diagram-Farming Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers a miniature diagram-forming circuit, which is obtained through the use of artificial transmission lines. Standard topology of the Butler matrix, and its area is 9947 mm2, this design has a large area not used at all. For this reason, the topology of such a matrix was miniaturized using original artificial lines. The intersection of two microstrip lines is implemented in several layers. The compact Butler matrix on a FR4 substrate and a central frequency of 1000 MHz has an area of 4963.725 mm2. As a result, with the use of cells it was possible to reduce the matrix area by half with a relatively small deterioration in the characteristics of the device - the frequency band decreased and the imbalance between the transmission coefficients increased. An additional reduction in size is possible due to a denser arrangement of elements in the inner space. The proposed scheme can find its application as a power supply for small antenna arrays on board ships.

articleTitle: Low area QCA Demultiplexer Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Demultiplexer is used in communication systems to convert the serial data to the parallel data. A demultiplexer receives the output signals from the multiplexer. For that reason, it is important components for making integrated circuit. This work target is designing a high optimized demultiplexer in QCA framework. We proposed a designs of 1:4 demultiplexer and the simulation results reveal that our proposed designs have significant improvements, such as low complexity and power consumption aspects.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Steganographic Hiding of Information Using a File System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes a method to hide data by modifying directory index entry information in NTFS file system. By modifying the file names of several index entries to make them duplicated, if the duplicated files are deleted, then the only the original file is deleted, but the modified files are retained in the MFT entry intact. So, the fact that these files are hidden is not exposed. The file contents hiding is to allocate data to be hidden on an empty index record page that is not used. If many files are made in the directory, several 4KB index records are allocated. NTFS leaves the empty index records unchanged after deleting the files. By modifying the run-list of the index record with the cluster number of the file-to-hide, the contents of the file-to-hide are hidden in the index record. By applying the analyses method to the case of hiding two files, the file lists are not exposed in the file explorer and the command prompt window, and the contents of the file-to-hide are hidden in the empty index record. It is proved that the analyzed method has effectiveness and validity.

articleTitle: Estimation of the reliability of fiber-optical communication lines taking into account the influence of external factors using the semi-Markov model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One of the important tasks of the theory of reliability and efficiency of fiber-optic communication lines is the task of creating information control systems for optical communication networks and the transition to intelligent control and engineering. The solution to this problem is possible on the basis of constructing mathematical models concerning various aspects of the structure and functioning of these systems. The paper considers the possibilities of using semi-Markov processes with a common phase space of states, hidden Markov and semi-Markov models for modeling fiber-optic communication lines.

Author Keywords: characteristics of reliability and efficiency of communication lines

articleTitle: Analysis of Algorithms for Electronic Digital Signature with Increased Security
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes the mathematical problems of electronic digital signature algorithms and their classification. The Schnorr algorithm with increased stock is described.

articleTitle: Equipment and Software for Energy Supply Monitoring and Control Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The parameters of probability and operation of control units are mainly determined on the basis of research of state of work and failure of elements conversion-formation of control signal. During research of reliability and probability of operational parameters of control units of monitoring and controlling devices, necessary to determine probability parameters of functioning elements, involved to formation of output signal, based on primary electrically, magnetically, thermal and other quantities and values. The results of control are recorded in non-volatile memory for storage if device operates in the measurement mode, and also displayed on the display.

articleTitle: Increasing the Effectiveness of Teaching the Theory of Probability and Mathematical Statistics on the Basis of Context Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes examples of specialties in the teaching of probability theory and mathematical statistics (PT and MS) in higher education institutions and pedagogical conditions for improving the effectiveness of education through the use of information and communication tools in laboratory classes.

articleTitle: A model for preventing malicious traffic in DNS servers using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper describes how to attack DNS servers and a system architecture for the real-time packet classification process to recognize the occurrence of DNS server tunneling is offered. As well as, a packet classification model to allow attacks based on machine learning is proposed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling Of Transport Demand Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Improving the quality of work in the development of transport infrastructure, revising outdated norms when intro-ducing modern information and communication technologies, im-proving standards and quality bringing them to world standards, ensuring the safety, popularity, reliability and sustainability of transport services, improving infrastructure, applying flexible tariffs and creating new promising routes, the digitization of the transport system, and the full satisfaction of the needs of urban passenger transport services require a number of targeted works. The article presents an analytical analysis of methods for optimizing. The specificity of their application is reflected, advantages and disadvantages are given.

articleTitle: Development of a mathematical model for balancing the level and device for remote monitoring of groundwater parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the use and development of a mathematical model for calculating the items of the balance of the flow of information, for example, for water supply of economic facilities.

Author Keywords: water supply of national economic objects

articleTitle: Model and Numerical Algorithm for Monitoring and Forecasting Transfer and Diffusion of Active Aerosol Particles in the Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of protecting the environment from negative anthropogenic impacts. Violations of the existing ecological balance in regions with a high anthropogenic load, and, first of all, persistent air pollution, cause a lot of problems - the growth of oncological, allergic, asthmatic and other diseases among the population, deterioration of the fertility of agricultural land, the state of flora and fauna. A mathematical model and a numerical algorithm describing the process of spread of active aerosol particles are developed in the article for monitoring, forecasting and making management decisions on the protection of the boundary layer of the atmosphere, the underlying mobility of the ground, soil, and groundwater, The model and algorithm take into account the weather and climatic factors, rates of forward and reverse reactions and the reaction rate of decomposition of mixture under the influence of chemical reaction. A finite-difference numerical algorithm of a high order of accuracy in spatial variables and in time was developed for numerical integration.

Author Keywords: transfer and diffusion of active aerosol particles

articleTitle: A Creation Cryptographic Protocol for the Division of Mutual Authentication and Session Key
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper is devoted a creation cryptographic protocol for the division of mutual authentication and session key. For secure protocols, suitable cryptographic algorithms were monitored.

articleTitle: Approaches and Methods for Assessing the Information Security of Data Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The report examines approaches to assessing the information security of data transmission networks (DTN). The analysis of methods for quantitative assessment of information security risks is carried out. A methodological approach to the assessment of IS DTN based on the risk-oriented method is presented. A method for assessing risks based on the mathematical apparatus of the queening systems (QS) is considered and the problem of mathematical modeling is solved.

articleTitle: Development of a Model for the Functioning of Non-Recoverable Equipment of Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes the methodology for developing a model of the functioning of non-recoverable equipment for telecommunications systems. To ensure the reliability of the equipment of telecommunications systems, it is proposed to connect a backup element instead of a failed element. The purpose of the study is to increase the reliability of telecommunications information transmission systems. The research methodology is based on modeling the functioning of non-recoverable equipment when connecting a backup element of a telecommunications system. As a result, it is proposed to obtain a formula for evaluating the reliability of the system, both in the case of a loaded reserve and in the case of an unloaded reserve. This allows us to build a model of the functioning of non-recoverable equipment of telecommunications systems.

articleTitle: Reflexive and adiabatic boundary 2D linear cellular automata and evolution of image patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One can study geometrical models of image patterns generated by CA evolution. For this, the present paper has investigated theoretical and imaginary investigation of two-dimensional (2D) linear and uniform cellular automata (CA). We study 2D linear CA under special boundary (reflexive and adiabatic) conditions over the binary field <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{Z}_{2}$</tex>, i.e. two states case. We investigate the evolution of image patterns corresponding to the uniform linear rules of 2D CA with the reflexive and adiabatic boundary conditions over <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{Z}_{2}$</tex>. The linear rules of CA can be found to be some image copies of a given first image depending on the special boundary types.

articleTitle: Basic principles of wavelet filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the world, the development of modern information and communication technologies and their implementation in various industries are important. Digital filtering of noisy signals and images is important in solving a wide range of scientific and technical problems. Such problems arise, in particular, in communication technology to improve the quality of reception of transmitted messages.

articleTitle: Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) Traffic Filtering Method to Prevent Attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper analyzes methods for both detecting and preventing DHCP attacks. A flow scheme for DHCP packet filtering and a workflow scheme for DHCP depletion prevention is proposed, starting with the registration process that must be performed by each WLAN client that will join the network. As well as an algorithm flowchart for filtering DHCP packets based on DSCP is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of existing smart crossroads and a new approach of smart crossroad
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The number of vehicles is increasing significantly all over the world, especially in large urban areas. The resulting congestion has become a key issue and new research topic for transport professionals and decision makers. This study took into account current solutions for smart intersections, traffic lights, as well as an analysis of existing methods and the introduction of new innovative approaches to improve traffic at intersections. This article describes several solutions for smart intersections from around the world, about the unique capabilities of these solutions, a comparison with and without integration of smart intersections, and also describes a method to improve traffic at intersections using artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: International Experience in the Organisation of a Multimedia-Based Distance Learning System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the leading countries of the world has become a trend organization of networking for distance education. The intensity of this process is due not only to market needs for skilled workers, the merits of distance learning, innovation in the sector of IT, but also the fact that the development of training programs have actively joined the world's largest computer company, indicating the importance of market distance education for national economies.

articleTitle: 2D Pentagonal von Neumann Cellular Automata with Periodic Boundary
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This work deals with the theory 2-dimensional (2D), uniform periodic boundary replications cellular automata (2D PB CA) of linear rules. We investigate a 2D CA with PB over the binary field Z pcase, i.e. p-state spin case.

articleTitle: Stages of Processing an Information Security Incident
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the stages of information security incident processing, approaches to the classification of information security incidents, and incident categorization. Further actions after the incident is resolved are shown. Some tips are given on minimizing or neutralizing the vulnerability that led to the implementation of a security threat

articleTitle: Steps Of Organizing The Methodology Of Improvement Of Methods Of Distance Learning Of Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The recommendations about the pedagogical-psychological, didactic, design, technical, user requirements, the structure and creation steps of the plan-project of methodology of the distance learning which belong to methodology of the distance learning are given in this article. The standards and best practices of analyzing, projecting, evaluating of distance learning development are given attention in the research. Also, the principles of taking into account additional opinions in relation to the requirements of the distance learning environment in order to choose methodology in preparing distance learning lessons are given. The proposed methodology consists of three steps in each step, in general, total steps consists of seven steps. The algorithm of the development process of these steps will be given in detail in this article. This distance learning methodology can be used as the effective guide to achieve the objectives and needs of the students as much as possible and further improvement of traditional learning.

articleTitle: Gradient descent in machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence(AI) covered industries, social medias and even art. That's why every research in this sphere consider significant. This article explained algorithm of “Gradient Descent” in Machine Learning(ML) and Deep Learning(DL), also modified this algorithm for some logical exercises.

articleTitle: Exchange of Messages in the Telecommunication Network with Different Types of Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of determining the main quality indicators of a telecommunications network with different types of communication channels and the time-varying structure of their functioning to ensure the specified reliability, reliability and time of delivery of protected messages to information consumers. The main method of solving this problem is using analytical and simulation methods on personal computers.

articleTitle: Modeling Agreement of Resources in a Distributed Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is shown that the processes of information exchange in complex distributed structures require appropriate control mechanisms based on a proper description that takes into account various sequences of formation of message components, which should be described on the basis of streaming models of distributed computing that determine the general approach for solving problems of analysis and synthesis of functional architecture in the plane of properties a quantitative assessment of the probabilistic-temporal parameters of the information exchange process, taking into account the parameters of the procedures implemented at various levels by the relevant protocols, as well as determining the general nature of the relationship taking into account the parameters of the procedures.

Author Keywords: agreement tasks and coordination of resources
representation of a network as a distributed managed structure

articleTitle: Development of a Linear Risk Model Based on Bipolar Fuzzy Sets in Poorly-Formed Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper a risk strategy is developed that included several steps. The application of bipolar fuzzy sets to assess the risk given by the initial data in the fuzzy state is proposed. The main indicators of risk are given. An algorithm for constructing a bipolar fuzzy model of risk is presented.

articleTitle: Design of Alternative Power Supply System Based On Flexible Mountable Smart Solar Roof for Movable Smart House
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper proposes the design of the Smart Solar roof conception. The general idea is an organization of autonomous power supply for Movable Smart House based on flexible mountable solar panels, which are integrated as a part of the building. Taking into account the fact that the solar panel itself is a semiconductor device that can detect the presence of light falling on it, current work proposes using solar panels as the VLC receiver. An experimental model was carried out with the purpose of smart house designing. Description of the working model of an autonomous movable smart house is given in this paper

articleTitle: Developing a Database of Uzbek Language Concatenative Speech Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today, it is difficult to imagine our life without modern intellectual technologies In this regard, computer linguistics, especially synthesizers that generate speech signals from text, plays an important role. This article discusses the creation of a database for the concatenative Uzbek speech synthesizer. A number of tasks are performed to organize the reading of the Uzbek text based on sound fragments. The main elements of the database and their properties are analyzed.

articleTitle: Security Scheme and Conceptual Model of Internet Banking System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper is given security and threat analyses of Uzbek and international internet bank systems. Also, main functions of internet banking are presented in example CLICK. The number of cybercrimes in Internet banking systems and security terms by percent are discussed. For protected transactions is proposed conceptual model and security scheme. At the end of the work is given some recommendations to secure client and seller information.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of the System for Student Progress Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One of the main components of education is the control of the quality of education - an assessment of the activities of each educational institution from the level of knowledge and skills of students (both by the teaching staff and external, state bodies), and the quality of the activities of teachers. This article describes the implementation of the results of a universal system of recording progress, which allows for based on a generalized unified mathematical model, generate a point-rating system that can satisfy the needs of all participants in the educational process.

Author Keywords: European credit transfer and accumulation system

articleTitle: The Transition Economy of the Republic Uzbekistan and Marketing Management in the Case of ICT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Current work discusses the main directions of economic reforms, implications of ICT in the economy and rising concerns of information security. The paper also considers marketing management in a market economy and the field of information and communication technologies using the economic policy reforms in Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: Statement of the Problem of Forming and Setting the Parameters of the Terms Linguistic Variable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the choice of the test criteria aimed at assessing the adequacy of the constructed model to a real object. The form representation of the membership functions to the terms of the corresponding linguistic variables is chosen and theoretically substantiated. It was revealed that one of the factors that has a strong influence on the degree adequacy of the linguistic model to the object of diagnostics is the setting parameters for the formation of terms accessories functions of the corresponding linguistic variable. The use of the gradient method of steepest descent for the solution of the problem to automatic adjustment with the parameters of the terms accessories functions in order to achieve the maximum adequacy of the designed model to the real object has been selected and theoretically substantiated.

articleTitle: Information and measurement control systems for technological processes in the grain processing industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a method to obtain the measurement results do not depend on the resistance-controlled material, and discusses the influence of the effect of active compensation of losses on the frequency of the generator, which serves as the synthesis of new measuring devices block moisture control pastes. To improve the efficiency of technology, organization of control, quantitative accounting of raw materials, products, process control, it is necessary to introduce an automated control system for managing technological processes. For this purpose, mathematical models of the dielectric permittivity of heterogeneous wet systems and ways to increase the reliability and accuracy of the results of monitoring the humidity of materials by the dielkometric method using information-measuring systems are analyzed. The mathematical description of the study of the effect of compensation of active losses on the frequency of the generator for humidity control devices of granular materials and the design of the high-frequency method and the design of humidity control devices of capacitive measuring transducers based on it are considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chromatic Dispersion on the Performance of a Standard Single Mode Fiber-Optics Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Fiber-Optics networks are high capacity systems that meet quickly developing a request for transmission capacity within the developing Telecommunication industry. However, there are a few impedance components that hinder the optimal effectiveness of Fiber-Optics Innovation. The broadening of light pulses, called dispersion, may be a primary factor is limiting the quality of flag transmission over optical links. Dispersion could be a result of the physical properties of the transmission medium. Single-mode filaments, utilized in high-speed optical systems, are subject to Chromatic Dispersion (CD) that causes beat broadening depending on wavelength. This paper centres on analyzing Chromatic Dispersion induced penalties within the transmission link. In addition, it presents an analysis of Chromatic Dispersion Compensation (CDC) technique in a 10 Gb/s Fiber-Optic transmission link by simulating the effects of CD using OptSim virtual instrument. The performance analysis is described in terms of the received transmission power, the estimated bit error ratio (BER) and the Q-factor are observed from the eve diagrams.

articleTitle: On one method for using quantum polarization filters in encryption
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The aim of this work is an attempt to improve the symmetric DES encryption algorithm using a quantum polarization filter. Assess the advantages and disadvantages of using polarizing filters. The main feature of the proposed scheme is that the encrypted message, in addition to the standard key, also uses polarization filters. The stability of the circuit is based on the high complexity of solving the problem of finding polarizing filters and the non-linearity of operations with these filters. Possible uses for polarizing filters are discussed.

articleTitle: Web application firewall method for detecting network attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article shows the characteristics of the Web Application Firewall and a comparison with other security systems. The functions of WAF that differ from the protective systems of previous generations are compared. The most well-known additional features of modern application-level security screens are listed. Interaction with vulnerability scanners is shown. The user rules for detecting illegitimate requests are given.

articleTitle: Model of traffic control system in the atm network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research work is devoted to the development of an analytical model of a traffic management system for an ATM network. The work considers a queuing system in which the intensity of the incoming flow changes depending on the level of filling of the buffer storage of the switch, the probabilistic - temporal characteristics of the two-level traffic control system were obtained and numerical studies of the mechanism of two-level restriction of incoming traffic were carried out for various buffer parameters, levels of restriction and load.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Algorithm for Nonlinear Adaptive Image Contrast Enhancement Based on the Theory of Fuzzy Sets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, primary image processing is used to improve recognition results. In this paper, improvements have been performed using normalization and phasing operations to increase image contrast. A normalized histogram has been also built. Mathematical expectations have been built for normalized and fuzzy image contrast enhancements. Shannon's entropy has been represented as fuzzy. Results of image sharpening have been presented and advantages over other algorithms have been indicated in the paper.

articleTitle: Improving and Evaluating Methods Network Attack Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper describes network attacks, their classification, detection technologies, architecture and structures. It also describes the advantages and disadvantages of attack detection systems, as well as methods to improve and evaluate the effectiveness of anomaly-based systems.

articleTitle: The process of extensive use of computer graphics in the diagnosis of renal function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research paper is devoted to the analysis of the processes of extensive use of the capabilities of computer graphics in medical diagnostic processes. In this article the scientific researches of researchers in the field is overviewed and analyzed. In the process of analysis of these scientific works, their scientific basis, tasks and methodology, the achieved scientific results are considered. In the result of article wire-frame modeling and its using are explained.

articleTitle: The Role Of Text Pragmatics In The Study Of Computer Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The most urgent task is to develop Uzbek computer linguistics on the basis of new, modern technologies and programs, as well as to create linguistic software for efficient, compact, convenient and affordable computer programs. The article provides information about the development of Uzbek computer linguistics, scientists who have contributed to the development of science. Issues such as the text, which is the main source of research in computer linguistics, and the role of pragmatics in its study are explained using examples. In the creation of translation programs, as well as research in the field of text editing, ideas on how to take into account the internal capabilities of the language, as well as relevant recommendations on the priorities of science and the work to be done in this regard.

articleTitle: Methods and algorithms of geometric modeling of fractal structured objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article presents methods and algorithms for geometric modeling of objects with fractal structures. Analytical equations of fractal structures were constructed using geometric shapes and their basic concepts. Algorithms have been developed using methods of R-function, binomial theorem, and two-dimensional geometric transformation in the 2D plane of computer graphics. The fractal dimension of the fractal based on the Pascal triangle was determined. The expressions obtained on the basis of the developed algorithm are presented in the form of a formula. A software tool was developed based on the algorithms developed using the presented methods. This software tool allows you to automate the interior and exterior decoration, equipment and design of the room in home construction, decorating construction products with patterns, creating patterns of carpets, designing them and choosing the colors and patterns of their products. The results obtained using the software tool are presented graphically.

articleTitle: Improvement of groundwater monitoring on the basis of modern info-communication and GIS technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes the methodology for improving the monitoring system of groundwater on the basis of modern information and communication and GIS technologies, which allows: firstly, to significantly reduce the time for collecting and analyzing information for making operational management decisions and, secondly, to greatly increase the reliability, to eliminate the human factor, as well as: visualize in the form of digital data on the level, chemical composition and physical properties of groundwater; assess the state of flooded areas, as well as carry out a comprehensive assessment of these areas based on the use of modern hardware and software, integrate, analyze and provide information support for making managerial decisions to prevent negative consequences.

articleTitle: Designing an interface for the exchange of information and energy resources between mobile devices via Type-C
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is for users to quickly, reliably and efficiently master the power of other mobile devices or exchange information between mobile devices to recharge their mobile devices while on the road, on the road, reading or elsewhere about designing the creation of a micro USB data exchange interface with no redundancies.

articleTitle: Approaches to Formalizing the Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: this paper proposes a canonical statement of the issue of restriction of use by synthesizing multi-criteria and restriction schemes that allow taking into account the main components of information security - confidentiality and usability as the most important features of computer systems. A conceptual model of a restriction system has been developed. The conceptual model of the general use restriction system reflects the important factors of the process and is the basis for the development of specific formal models and methods for the construction and operation of the use management system.

articleTitle: Marine MATV systems use a 3 dB reduction coupler with broadband
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The object of this study is a directional coupler with reduced dimensions and a wide frequency band. The purpose of the work is to implement a compact coupler with equal power division. To reduce the area, original artificial transmission lines were used. Due to the use of such lines, it was possible to reduce the area by 73.5%, taking into account the FR4 substrate material and the operating frequency of 0.9 GHz.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Two-level Control System for Nonlinear Dynamic Objects with a Neurofuzzy Adaptive Regulator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the construction of a two-level control system for dynamic objects with nonlinear properties, functioning under conditions of a priori uncertainty. The lower level of control includes local controllers that provide the closed-loop system with parametric invariance to variations in the parameters of the object and compensate for the effects of external and internal disturbances. For the upper control level, it is proposed to apply control algorithms based on methods of fuzzy logic and neural networks. A comparative analysis of the results obtained with the classical adaptive controller is carried out.

articleTitle: Analysis of the use of wavelets for processing signals of a seismological nature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the use of wavelets for processing signals of various nature, including seismic ones. Wavelet theory provides a convenient and effective tool for solving many practical problems.

articleTitle: The contribution of gate and drain voltages to temperature distribution along the channel in 2D MoS2 based MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper the self-heating effect in a nanoscale planar MOSFET with a two-dimensional MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> channel is investigated by simulations. The self-heating effect is simulated by using the thermodynamic transport model. Contribution of gate voltage and drain voltages to SHE, particularly to the temperature distribution along the center of channel is considered. It is shown that the temperature distribution along the channel and the temperature at the channel center considerably depend on the gate and drain voltages. The details of this influences is analysed.

articleTitle: Aggregation of Meteorological and Spatial Data for Air Pollution Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Manual preprocessing of raw data for air pollution modeling is often turns to quite painstaking job. In order to automate some basic routine of preprocessing the input information, we propose a method for consolidation of meteorological and spatial data provided by open web-services and repositories. The implemented algorithm can significantly reduce the time and costs for parameterization of the atmospheric boundary layer before solving the problems of evaluation and forecasting the environmental conditions of the industrial regions.

articleTitle: Transparent relativistic quantum networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper we consider Dirac equation on metric graphs. Dirac transparent boundary conditions are obtained using the vertex boundary conditions providing self-adjoint realization of the Dirac operator one metric star graph.

articleTitle: Modeling of Axisymmetric Jet Flow and Combustion of Propane in Free Space Based on a Modified Turbulence Model $\boldsymbol{k}-\mathcal{E}$
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper proposes a numerical method for solving the problem of the propagation of an axisymmetric propane jet in an infinite satellite air flow. Dimensionless equations of the turbulent boundary layer of reacting gases in the Mises coordinates are used for modeling. In order to close the Reynolds equations, a modified low-Reynolds turbulence model is used <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k-\varepsilon$</tex>. Considering the same intensities of convective and turbulent transfer of components and using stoichiometric relations between the concentrations of components during combustion, the five equations of transfer and conservation of components are reduced to two equations for relatively excessive concentration and combustible gas. To solve the problem in the Mises coordinates, a two-layer, six-point implicit finite-difference scheme is used, which provides a second-order accuracy of approximation by coordinates. Due to the nonlinearity of the equations of conservation and transfer of substances, an iterative process was organized. The influence of the radius of the fuel nozzle on the parameters of the turbulent jet and the torch is investigated.

articleTitle: As a mechanism that achieves the goal of decision management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Working with different data depending on the appearance and content of the object. Formation of types of objects and content of processes within the framework of human activity. Based on this, the control mechanism is also different. Management effects in the learning system are understood as the transfer of knowledge in the subject area to the student using the methods and tools formed by the teacher in the educational environment, taking into account all the factors generated in this process. The control system in this view is a simple system with a nonlinear feedback section. It combines complexes consisting of technical, software, telecommunications and methodological tools used in the educational process. They can be used to form alternative solutions not only by delivering parts of the training materials, but also by collecting and processing the information needed to manage the learning process. The training method is chosen according to the requirements of the learning environment and depends on the topic. If the chosen method is accepted, the training part is provided, which is fixed (question-answer or in another form), which makes it possible to work independently.

articleTitle: Building the Psychological Factors of Personality Towards Social Work
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper deals with the psychological factors having the essential role in the personality formation. It is noted that the formation of personality is a complex process of cognition, fixation, creative mastering world outlook, ideological, moral attitudes of society, the process of assimilation of social characteristics, knowledge and skills created by society, on the basis of which own vision and assessment of things is developed.

articleTitle: DDoS Attack Detection via IDS: Open Challenges and Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper discusses DDoS attacks, their current threat level and IDS systems, which are one of the main tools to protect against them. It focuses on the problems encountered by IDS systems in detecting DDoS attacks and the difficulties and challenges of integrating them with artificial intelligence systems today.

articleTitle: Use of neural networks in the exchange of cryptographic keys
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article proposes the use of neural networks in the exchange of cryptographic keys. An algorithm for generating a secret key based on a neural network has also been developed.

articleTitle: Imitation Models of the Railway Organization for Railway Transport Flows
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Considered the questions of solving the problem of optimization of cargo traffic management in the railway transport throughout the logistics chain, organizing the formation and implementation of cargo loading plans that do not allow exceeding the maximum and reduce the minimum levels of availability of a particular cargo on the destination road. And also the article justifies the solution of the problem of finding the maximum flow in the railway network, it is noted that in any transport network the maximum flow is equal to the minimum capacity. If the flow is maximal, then there is a section whose transmission capacity is equal to the cardinality of the flow and this theorem is proved by applying the Ford-Falkerson algorithm. The solution to the problem of finding the maximum flow in a railway network is based on Ford-Falkerson: in any transport network, the maximum flow is equal to the minimum capacity. If the flow is maximal, then there is a section whose transmission capacity is equal to the power of the stream. This theorem is proved by applying the Ford-Falkerson algorithm. According to this algorithm, starting with some initial incomplete flow, it is possible to obtain the total flow by the iterative algorithm if we add the minimum of the numbers, to the different values of the flows of the path, which are computed from this ways. After such an operation, the path contains at least one unsaturated arc. If you do the same way with other paths, then, in the end, we get the full stream.

articleTitle: Fiber optic temperature sensors in the aircraft fuel system application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Due to increasing requirements to the reliability and safety of the aircraft fuel system, as well as in order to reduce the cost of the system production and maintenance, an important development direction of fuel system is reducing of the number of electrical wires inside the fuel tanks. This article discusses the possibility of using explosion-proof fiber-optic temperature sensors with Fiber Bragg Grating in aircraft fuel systems instead of traditional electrical sensors, such as thermistors and thermocouples. For these fiber-optic sensors the basic relationships of the physical parameters, as well as the possibilities of their implementation in aircraft fuel system is shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of different clinical forms of viral hepatitis B disease
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Different clinical forms of viral hepatitis B disease are observed in liver cells (LC) under the pressure of hepatitis B viruses (HBV). This paper analyzes various clinical forms of viral hepatitis B disease observed in liver cells under the pressure of hepatitis B viruses based on a mathematical model of the activity of the regulator mechanisms of the molecular-genetic system of liver cells and hepatitis B viruses and develops software to perform computational experiments. Computational experiments were performed on the basis of the developed software, some results were obtained and their analysis was presented.

articleTitle: Study of national heritage sites on the basis of gamification technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Continuation of the game technology in the Great Project is the creation of interactive visual content for the study of national historical monuments in the territory of Uzbekistan. The developer visual software system is a software update system that can be fully implemented in the visual presence of our historical cultural sites, visual participation in our national historical sites, introduction of our historical sites to world-class observers, strengthening cultural integration in social distance. Increasing the cognitive activity of those who study historical and cultural sites. Makes the learning process better and more fun.

articleTitle: Modeling of Problem Reconstruction Function by its Integral Data on a Family of Circles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We consider the problem of reconstruction a function if its integrals over families of circles are known. An analytical representation is obtained for the Fourier image in the first variable of the desired function. This implies a statement about the strong incorrectness of the solution to the problem. Based on the idea of A.N. Tikhonov on the regularization of ill-posed problems, a sequence of approximate solutions to the exact solution of the problem is constructed.

articleTitle: Information and Communications Technology Integration in Language Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Information and Communications Technology has today become a major sort of debate among the world. Its impact is profound. In this era, the world of education in general and that of languages in particular knows a deep reform and evolution, in order to face up the new challenges, education has to adapt and renew itself. Today, we cannot imagine our personal and professional lives without the use of computers and smart devices as they play a vital role in all spheres of modern life. The application of the information technology in foreign language learning and teaching has already become integral part of our language classroom. Consequently, a vast number of educational platforms and software programs have been created and become the perfect complement in reaching proficiency and fluency, and language courses integrated by technological support are the most effective and attractive for students who want to be successful in language learning. The use of ICT in language learning maximizes a lot of new possibilities for effective communication for both teachers and the students not only to develop their language skills, but also they broaden knowledge of using ICT successfully to make teaching and learning better.

articleTitle: Algorithm for solving boundary value problems of parabolic equations and 3D visualization of results
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents the solution of the boundary differential equation of parabolic type using numerical methods. The block diagram of the calculation algorithm and the developed software can be used in the analysis and forecasting of filtration processes in oil fields. The numerical results obtained are presented graphically in a visual form and compared with the exact solutions.

articleTitle: Composite Cascode Injection-Voltaic Transistor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the developed composite cascode injection-voltaic transistor, which provides a high current gain and manufacturability of the transistor using the same type of transistor structures made on semiconductors with the same band gap.

articleTitle: Study on Aircraft Lightweight fuselage Structure Design Using flexible solar panel for Solar-Powered Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The power supply systems today are the theme of many arguments and researches. The bad ecological condition of many developed countries makes researchers seek solutions in renewable natural or alternate resources for power supply. Methods to provide mobile and safe energy with low cost do still not exist. How to transport the power factory to far place fast and safe it is a challenge. The fastest way is aircraft, but how long aircraft can stay in the sky without re-fueling? The needs for aeronautic technologies are high as the flights and making scientific and engineering world also to seek solutions in the energy supply sphere. Solving the problems of powering during the flight and provide the excess of power to other needs, is the key goal of modern integrated ecological systems. This article is devoted to obtaining electricity by establishing lighter-than-air aircraft systems that maintain their coordinates for a long flight time in the stratosphere. The flexible solar panels built into the fuselage of the aircraft are the main elements of obtaining electrical energy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management Model Of Business Processes Of Production With The Use Of Fuzzy Logic Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article substantiates the relevance of the application of fuzzy-multiple approach to the evaluation of business processes of an enterprise. Currently, there is no unambiguity in determining the system of indicators to evaluate the business processes of the enterprise. The analysis of existing classifications of performance indicators of business processes has allowed to allocate two directions of their formation. The first direction is the allocation of groups of indicators in accordance with the characteristics of the process. The second direction is associated with the definition of groups of indicators to assess various elements of business process. In our opinion, such a system of indicators should include both quantitative and qualitative parameters. In recent years, more and more domestic enterprises in order to increase their competitiveness are trying to organize their activities on the basis of modern scientific research. Thus, one of the promising areas of scientific research in the field of analysis, forecasting and modeling of enterprise processes is fuzzy logic. The use of fuzzy logic in assessing the activities of an enterprise can improve the validity of management decisions.

articleTitle: Basic concepts and stages of research development on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes artificial intelligence, which is now widely used and developed in the field of information technology and is a part of our life. The basic concepts and classifications of artificial intelligence, its features, areas of research, analytical data on the stages of development are described. At the same time, the role and functions of artificial intelligence in intelligent systems, as well as approaches in the field of application are presented.

articleTitle: Algebraic structure of parametric elliptic curves
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The advantage of elliptic curve (EC) cryptographic systems is that they provide equivalent security even with small key lengths. However, the development of modern computing technologies leads to an increase in the length of keys. In this case, it is recommended to use a secret parameter to ensure sufficient access without increasing the key length. To achieve this result, the initiation of an additional secret parameter R into the EC equation is used to develop an EC-based key distribution algorithm. The article describes the algebraic structure of an elliptic curve with a secret parameter.

articleTitle: Organization of Initial Text Processing in the Uzbek Language Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The development of modern methods and technologies requires the creation of light and simple forms of the human-machine interface. In this regard, computational linguistics plays an important role, especially synthesizers that generate speech signals from the text. This paper discusses the process of organizing primary text processing for the Uzbek speech synthesizer. Some tasks are performed to group the existing elements of the text and prepare them for dubbing. The types of syllables in the Uzbek language are studied, the issues of dividing words into syllables are considered.

articleTitle: Application geoinformational technologies in hydrogeological research
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Currently, there is a steady growth in the needs of all spheres of the country's economy for unified spatial information. The importance of modernity, reliability and accuracy of geological, ie, spatial data, is growing exponentially, which places high demands on their timely updating in operational terms up to updating in a mode close to real time. Analysis of works using methods and geoinformation technologies of mapping showed that digital topographic maps do not fully meet the requirements of geoinformation cartographic framework when used in GIS, which is explained by the following factors: a complex system of classification and coding of map objects; - duplication of qualitative and quantitative characteristics in the signatures of objects on the map; the presence of design objects in the content of maps; lack of summaries between nomenclature sheets of digital topographic maps; incompatibility of formats and software versions used in the process of updating maps. To solve this problem, it is necessary to provide for the development of a unified geoinformation cartographic support, which includes classifiers of geospatial information, rules for digital description of spatial information, digital libraries of conventional symbols.

articleTitle: Results of the working of the high-precision iterative decoding system in the code efficiency comparison mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, a software module has been developed that accurately imitates the work of the developed system of high-precision iterative coding and decoding to evaluate the effectiveness of existing multi-threshold algorithms and the developed high-precision iterative decoding algorithm, as well as to obtain the probabilistic-energy characteristics of the corresponding algorithms. Experimental results of the operation of the high-precision iterative decoding system in the mode of comparison of the efficiency of codes are presented, which are compared to various types of codes with comprehensive criteria. Further application of high-precision iterative codes in digital TV broadcasting systems is considered.
